records.literal_gloss: From then sixth hour darkness came over all the land until hour ninth.

en.L: Now from [the] sixth hour darkness came over all the land until [the] ninth hour.
en.B: At noon darkness fell over the whole land, and it lasted until three in the afternoon.
en.R: At twelve o'clock noon, the whole land became dark. It stayed dark until three o'clock in the afternoon.

es.L: Y desde la hora sexta hubo oscuridad sobre toda la tierra hasta la hora novena.
es.B: Desde el mediodía hasta las tres de la tarde, la oscuridad cubrió toda la tierra.
es.R: A las doce del mediodía, toda la tierra quedó a oscuras. Siguió oscuro hasta las tres de la tarde.

fr.L: Or, depuis la sixième heure, il y eut des ténèbres sur tout le pays jusqu’à la neuvième heure.
fr.B: À partir de midi, l’obscurité se fit sur tout le pays, et elle dura jusqu’à quinze heures.
fr.R: À midi, tout le pays est devenu sombre. Il a fait noir jusqu’à trois heures de l’après-midi.

sw.L: Basi tangu saa sita giza liliingia juu ya nchi yote mpaka saa tisa.
sw.B: Tangu saa sita mchana giza liliifunika nchi yote, likadumu mpaka saa tisa.
sw.R: Saa sita mchana nchi yote ikawa giza. Giza likaendelea mpaka saa tisa alasiri.

vi.L: Vả, từ giờ thứ sáu, bóng tối bao trùm khắp cả xứ cho đến giờ thứ chín.
vi.B: Từ giữa trưa, bóng tối bao phủ khắp xứ cho đến ba giờ chiều.
vi.R: Lúc mười hai giờ trưa, cả xứ trở nên tối tăm. Trời tối như vậy cho đến ba giờ chiều.

ko.L: 그런데 여섯째 시부터 아홉째 시까지 온 땅에 어둠이 덮였다.
ko.B: 낮 열두 시가 되자 온 땅이 어둠에 덮였고, 그 어둠은 오후 세 시까지 계속되었다.
ko.R: 낮 열두 시가 되자 온 땅이 캄캄해졌다. 오후 세 시까지 계속 어두웠다.

am.L: ከስድስተኛውም ሰዓት ጀምሮ እስከ ዘጠነኛው ሰዓት ድረስ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።
am.B: ከቀኑ ስድስት ሰዓት ጀምሮ እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ድረስ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።
am.R: እኩለ ቀን ላይ፣ በቀኑ ስድስት ሰዓት፣ ምድር ሁሉ ጨለመች። እስከ ቀኑ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ድረስ ጨለማ ሆኖ ቆየ።

decisions.choice: the sixth hour, the ninth hour: about noon and about three in the afternoon
decisions.reason: Jews and Romans counted the hours of daylight from sunrise, about six in the morning (20:3-6).

decisions.choice: the land: the land of Israel, or the whole earth
decisions.reason: The same word can mean land or earth. Matthew does not say how far the darkness reached.

decisions.choice: darkness: a sign of God's judgment
decisions.reason: Amos 8:9 says that on that day God will make the sun go down at noon. Darkness also covered Egypt before the Passover (Exodus 10:22). Passover fell at full moon, when an eclipse of the sun cannot happen.

decisions.choice: noon, three in the afternoon (B); twelve o'clock noon, three o'clock in the afternoon (R)
alternatives: the sixth hour, the ninth hour
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the ancient way of counting the hours. Balanced and Readable give the time as we count it, as in Mark 15:33.

decisions.choice: toda la tierra
decisions.reason: "Tierra" can mean both the land and the whole earth, so Spanish keeps the question of meaning decision m2 open at every level.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); speech keeps its own tenses at every level
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Matthew and in Mark 15: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, and Readable tells the story in the passé composé. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: la sixième heure, la neuvième heure (L); midi, quinze heures (B); midi, trois heures de l’après-midi (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 15:33-34 and Matthew 20:5 in French: Balanced uses the twenty-four-hour clock that French writes, Readable the way the hour is said in speech.

decisions.choice: saa sita, saa tisa at every level; Readable adds mchana, alasiri
alternatives: saa sita usiku (a conversion as in the English)
decisions.reason: The Greek counts the hours from sunrise, as Swahili time does, so the sixth hour is "saa sita" (noon) and the ninth "saa tisa" (three in the afternoon) with no conversion (meaning decision m1). The same in 27:46. "Nchi" keeps both the land and the earth open (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "giờ thứ sáu ... giờ thứ chín" (L); modern clock times (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide says for clock time, and as in the Vietnamese Mark 15:33: Literal keeps the Greek count, Balanced and Readable give the modern hour.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 27:45-66; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서", "그분" and -시-
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "여섯째 시", "아홉째 시" (L); "낮 열두 시", "오후 세 시" (B, R), here and in 27:46
alternatives: the Greek count at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek count, Balanced and Readable give the modern time (style guide, section 5), as the Korean Mark 15:33-34 does.

decisions.choice: "ከስድስተኛው ሰዓት ... እስከ ዘጠነኛው ሰዓት" (L); "ከቀኑ ስድስት ሰዓት ... እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት" (B); "እኩለ ቀን ላይ, በቀኑ ስድስት ሰዓት" (R)
alternatives: "ከቀትር ... እስከ ቀኑ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት" with Western clock times
decisions.reason: The Greek counts the hours from sunrise, as Ethiopians do, so the sixth and ninth hours are "ስድስት ሰዓት" and "ዘጠኝ ሰዓት" on the Ethiopian clock, noon and three in the afternoon. Balanced and Readable can therefore give the hour as Amharic readers tell the time; Readable adds "እኩለ ቀን" (noon).

source.text: περὶ δὲ τὴν ἐνάτην ὥραν ἀνεβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων· Ἠλὶ ἠλὶ λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι;

records.literal_gloss: About then the ninth hour cried out the Jesus with voice loud saying, Eli eli lema sabachthani?

en.L: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?"
en.B: At about three o'clock Jesus gave a loud cry: "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?"
en.R: At about three o'clock Jesus shouted loudly, "Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?"

es.L: Y alrededor de la hora novena Jesús clamó a gran voz, diciendo: «Elí, Elí, ¿lema sabactani?».
es.B: Hacia las tres de la tarde, Jesús lanzó un fuerte grito: «Elí, Elí, ¿lema sabactani?».
es.R: A eso de las tres de la tarde, Jesús gritó con fuerza: «Elí, Elí, ¿lema sabactani?».

fr.L: Et vers la neuvième heure, Jésus cria d’une voix forte, disant : « Éli, Éli, lema sabachthani ? »
fr.B: Vers quinze heures, Jésus poussa un grand cri : « Éli, Éli, lema sabachthani ? »
fr.R: Vers trois heures de l’après-midi, Jésus a crié très fort : « Éli, Éli, lema sabachthani ? »

sw.L: Na karibu saa tisa Yesu alilia kwa sauti kuu, akisema, "Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani?"
sw.B: Karibu saa tisa Yesu alitoa kilio kikubwa: "Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani?"
sw.R: Karibu saa tisa alasiri Yesu alipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, "Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani?"

vi.L: Và khoảng giờ thứ chín, Đức Giê-xu kêu lớn tiếng: "Ê-li, Ê-li, lê-ma sa-bách-tha-ni?"
vi.B: Khoảng ba giờ chiều, Đức Giê-xu kêu lớn: "Ê-li, Ê-li, lê-ma sa-bách-tha-ni?"
vi.R: Khoảng ba giờ chiều, Đức Giê-xu kêu thật lớn: "Ê-li, Ê-li, lê-ma sa-bách-tha-ni?"

ko.L: 그리고 아홉째 시쯤에 예수께서 큰 소리로 외쳐 말씀하셨다. "엘리, 엘리, 레마 사박다니?"
ko.B: 오후 세 시쯤에 예수께서 큰 소리로 부르짖으셨다. "엘리, 엘리, 레마 사박다니?"
ko.R: 오후 세 시쯤에 예수께서 큰 소리로 외치셨다. "엘리, 엘리, 레마 사박다니?"

am.L: በዘጠነኛውም ሰዓት ገደማ ኢየሱስ በታላቅ ድምፅ፦ «ኤሊ፣ ኤሊ፣ ለማ ሰበቅታኒ?» ብሎ ጮኸ።
am.B: በቀኑ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ገደማ ኢየሱስ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ፦ «ኤሊ፣ ኤሊ፣ ለማ ሰበቅታኒ?»
am.R: በቀኑ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ገደማ ኢየሱስ ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ፦ «ኤሊ፣ ኤሊ፣ ለማ ሰበቅታኒ?» ብሎ ጮኸ።

decisions.choice: Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani: the first line of Psalm 22, Psalm 22:1 (22:2 in the Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: Jesus prays the opening of Psalm 22. The psalm moves from a cry of being forsaken to praise of God who rescues, at its end. Matthew has already echoed it in 27:35, 39 and 43.

decisions.choice: Eli ... sabachthani: the Hebrew form for my God, with an Aramaic verb
decisions.reason: Eli is close to the Hebrew of the psalm; sabachthani is Aramaic, the everyday language of Jews in Jesus's land. Mark 15:34 has the Aramaic Eloi. The sound of Eli explains why some heard the name Elijah (27:47).

decisions.choice: the spelling of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Manuscripts spell these words in several ways, some matching Mark. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani
decisions.reason: All levels keep the words in Latin letters, following the SBLGNT spelling, as Matthew keeps them and then translates them. The misunderstanding in 27:47 depends on their sound. Balanced and Readable give the hour as three o'clock, as in 27:45.

decisions.choice: Elí, Elí, ¿lema sabactani? (every level)
alternatives: Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani (the English spelling)
decisions.reason: As in English (rendering decision r-en-1), every level keeps the words Jesus said, spelled as Spanish reads them: "ch" would be read as in "chico", so "sabactani". "Elí" with its accent sits close to "Elías", which shows how the bystanders could hear the name (27:47).

decisions.choice: Éli, Éli, lema sabachthani
decisions.reason: Matthew has the Hebrew form of "my God", so French writes "Éli", with the accent French puts on the name; it sounds like "Élie", which is what the bystanders hear in 27:47.

decisions.choice: Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani? (every level)
decisions.reason: As in English (rendering decision r-en-1), every level keeps the words Jesus said, spelled as Swahili writes the sounds: "kh" becomes "k" and "th" is the sound of "thelathini". "Eli" sits close to "Eliya", which shows how the bystanders could hear the name (27:47).

decisions.choice: "Ê-li, Ê-li, lê-ma sa-bách-tha-ni?"
decisions.reason: The words are kept as sounds, as in the English, in the hyphenated Vietnamese way of writing foreign words; Matthew has the Hebrew form "Eli" (meaning decision), so it differs from the Vietnamese Mark 15:34, and its likeness to "Ê-li" (Elijah) explains the next verse.

decisions.choice: "엘리, 엘리, 레마 사박다니" at every level
decisions.reason: Matthew has the Hebrew "Eli" where Mark has the Aramaic "Eloi" (meaning decision); the Hangul follows the spelling of the SBLGNT, as the English does, so the bystanders' mishearing of "Elijah" in 27:47 can be heard.

decisions.choice: "ኤሊ፣ ኤሊ፣ ለማ ሰበቅታኒ" spelled out in Ethiopic letters
alternatives: "ኤሎሄ፣ ኤሎሄ, ላማ ሰበቅታኒ" (the form of Mark 15:34)
decisions.reason: The words are kept in their own language, as Matthew keeps them, and spelled from the SBLGNT's Eli and lema; the next sentence translates them.

source.text: τοῦτ’ ἔστιν· Θεέ μου θεέ μου, ἱνατί με ἐγκατέλιπες;

records.literal_gloss: That is, God of me, God of me, why me you forsook?

en.L: That is, "My God, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} God, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"
en.B: That means, "My God, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} God, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} abandoned {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"
en.R: These words mean, "My God, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} God, why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} left {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} all alone?"

es.L: Es decir: «Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, ¿por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desamparaste?».
es.B: Esto significa: «Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, ¿por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has abandonado?».
es.R: Estas palabras quieren decir: «Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, Dios {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, ¿por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has dejado tan solo?».

fr.L: C’est-à-dire : « Mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Dieu, pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} délaissé ? »
fr.B: Cela veut dire : « Mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Dieu, pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} abandonné ? »
fr.R: Ces mots veulent dire : « Mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Dieu, pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} laissé tout seul ? »

sw.L: Yaani, "Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kwa nini uliniacha?"
sw.B: Maana yake ni, "Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kwa nini umenitupa?"
sw.R: Maneno hayo maana yake ni, "Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Mungu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kwa nini umeniacha peke {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}?"

vi.L: Nghĩa là: "Đức Chúa Trời của con, Đức Chúa Trời của con, sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lìa bỏ con?"
vi.B: Nghĩa là: "Đức Chúa Trời của con, Đức Chúa Trời của con, sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bỏ con?"
vi.R: Những lời ấy có nghĩa là: "Đức Chúa Trời của con, Đức Chúa Trời của con, sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bỏ con một mình?"

ko.L: 이것은 "나의 하나님, 나의 하나님, 어찌하여 저를 버리셨습니까?"라는 뜻이다.
ko.B: 그것은 "나의 하나님, 나의 하나님, 왜 저를 버리셨습니까?"라는 뜻이다.
ko.R: 이 말은 "나의 하나님, 나의 하나님, 왜 저를 혼자 버려두셨습니까?"라는 뜻이다.

am.L: ይኸውም፦ «አምላኬ፣ አምላኬ፣ ለምን ተውኸኝ?» ማለት ነው።
am.B: ትርጉሙም፦ «አምላኬ፣ አምላኬ፣ ለምን ትተኸኛል?» ማለት ነው።
am.R: የእነዚህ ቃላት ትርጉም፦ «አምላኬ፣ አምላኬ፣ ለምን ብቻዬን ተውኸኝ?» ማለት ነው።

decisions.choice: my God: Jesus speaks to God
decisions.reason: Jesus addresses God and calls him "my God". Even in the cry of being forsaken he holds on to God as his own.

decisions.choice: forsaken: left behind, abandoned
decisions.reason: The verb means to leave someone alone in a time of need.

decisions.choice: the cry: Jesus's real anguish
decisions.reason: The words are a real cry of suffering, spoken in the words of Scripture. Matthew does not explain it further.

decisions.choice: my, you, me take the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: "My" and "me" are Jesus speaking of himself, and "you" is God. The first "My" starts the quoted sentence and is written plain. Readable uses plain words for forsaken.

decisions.choice: both {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} and {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} take the setting
alternatives: a span on the second "mío" only, as the English
decisions.reason: In English the first "My" begins the sentence and so has its capital already. Spanish puts the possessive after the noun, so both take the span, and "me" with it (rendering decision r-en-1). "Tú" is not written, so there is nothing to mark for "you". Throughout the passage, pronouns joined to the verb (salvarlo, crucificarlo) take no span.

decisions.choice: kwa nini uliniacha (L); kwa nini umenitupa (B); kwa nini umeniacha peke yangu (R)
decisions.reason: "Kwa nini" is the plain question "why"; "mbona" leans towards surprise or complaint. Literal keeps the Greek past tense; Balanced says "kunitupa" (cast me off), the sense of being abandoned (meaning decision m2); Readable "left me alone", as the English Readable. Both "wangu" and "yangu" take the deity_pronoun setting (rendering decision r-en-1); as throughout the passage, pronouns inside the verb (uliniacha) cannot take a capital and have no span.

decisions.choice: "con" for Jesus' "my" and "me", with no deity_pronoun span; God addressed as {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:34: Jesus prays the psalm as his own cry to God and calls himself "con", a noun of address with no capital form, so the English spans on "my" and "me" have no counterpart; the span stays on the pronoun for God.

decisions.choice: Jesus prays to God in 합쇼체 with "저" ("버리셨습니까?"), with no setting span
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 15:34 and as the psalmist speaks to God (style guide, sections 4 and 7a); the English spans have nothing to change in Korean.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: Marking pronouns for God in some other way
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Jesus in English has nothing to change in Amharic; here "you" and "me" are verb affixes (ተውኸኝ).

source.text: τινὲς δὲ τῶν ἐκεῖ ἑστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ οὗτος.

records.literal_gloss: Some then of those there standing having heard were saying that Elijah calls this one.

en.L: And some of those standing there, when they heard [it], were saying, "This [man] is calling Elijah."
en.B: Hearing it, some of those who stood nearby said, "This fellow is calling for Elijah!"
en.R: Some of the people standing there heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They said, "He is calling for Elijah!"

es.L: Y algunos de los que estaban allí, al oír[lo], decían: «Este llama a Elías».
es.B: Al oírlo, algunos de los que estaban cerca dijeron: «¡Ese está llamando a Elías!».
es.R: Algunos de los que estaban allí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oyeron. Dijeron: «¡Está llamando a Elías!».

fr.L: Et certains de ceux qui se tenaient là, l’ayant entendu, disaient : « Celui-ci appelle Élie. »
fr.B: En l’entendant, quelques-uns de ceux qui se tenaient là dirent : « Voilà cet homme qui appelle Élie ! »
fr.R: Des gens qui étaient là {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont entendu. Ils ont dit : « Il appelle Élie ! »

sw.L: Na baadhi ya wale waliokuwa wamesimama pale, waliposikia, walikuwa wakisema, "Huyu anamwita Eliya."
sw.B: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu waliposikia, walisema, "Huyu jamaa anamwita Eliya!"
sw.R: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama pale walimsikia. Wakasema, "Anamwita Eliya!"

vi.L: Và vài người trong số những người đứng đó, nghe [vậy], nói: "Người này gọi Ê-li."
vi.B: Một vài người đứng gần đó nghe vậy thì nói: "Gã này đang gọi Ê-li kìa!"
vi.R: Có mấy người đứng đó nghe thấy. Họ nói: "Ông ấy đang gọi Ê-li!"

ko.L: 그러자 거기 서 있던 사람들 가운데 몇이 듣고 말하고 있었다. "이 사람이 엘리야를 부른다."
ko.B: 곁에 서 있던 사람들 가운데 몇 사람이 이 말을 듣고 말했다. "저 사람이 엘리야를 부르는구나!"
ko.R: 거기 서 있던 사람들 가운데 몇이 이 소리를 들었다. 그들이 말했다. "저 사람이 엘리야를 부르고 있다!"

am.L: በዚያ ከቆሙትም አንዳንዶቹ ሰምተው፦ «ይህ [ሰው] ኤልያስን ይጠራል» ይሉ ነበር።
am.B: በአጠገቡ ከቆሙት አንዳንዶቹ ይህን ሰምተው፦ «ይህ ሰውዬ ኤልያስን እየጠራ ነው!» አሉ።
am.R: በዚያ ቆመው ከነበሩት ሰዎች አንዳንዶቹ ሰሙት። እነርሱም፦ «ኤልያስን እየጠራ ነው!» አሉ።

decisions.choice: Elijah: the prophet God promised to send
decisions.reason: God promised to send Elijah before the great day of the Lord (Malachi 4:5; 3:23 in the Hebrew). Jesus spoke of this in 11:14 and 17:10-13.

decisions.choice: calling Elijah: misheard, or twisted in mockery
decisions.reason: Eli sounds like the name Elijah. Whether they misheard or twisted his words to mock him, Matthew does not say.

decisions.choice: this one: perhaps said with scorn
decisions.reason: The pronoun can carry contempt, as "this fellow" does.

decisions.choice: this fellow
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the tone of the pronoun.

decisions.choice: Ese (B)
decisions.reason: Spanish "ese" said of a person on its own sounds dismissive, which gives the scorn of the English "this fellow" (meaning decision m3, rendering decision r-en-1).

decisions.choice: Huyu jamaa (B)
decisions.reason: "Jamaa" said of a stranger is offhand, which gives the scorn of the English "this fellow" (meaning decision m3, rendering decision r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "Người này" (L); "Gã này" (B); "Ông ấy" (R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The bystanders speak of Jesus as an ordinary man, perhaps with scorn (meaning decision); Balanced "gã" carries the English "this fellow". None of these words has a capital form for the setting.

decisions.choice: The bystanders speak of Jesus as "이 사람", "저 사람" with no honorific, through 27:49
decisions.reason: Perhaps said with scorn (meaning decision); as in the Korean Mark 15:35-36.

source.text: καὶ εὐθέως δραμὼν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ λαβὼν σπόγγον πλήσας τε ὄξους καὶ περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately having run one of them and having taken a sponge having filled and with sour wine and having put on a reed was giving to drink him.

en.L: And immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled [it] with sour wine, put [it] on a reed, and was giving {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a drink.
en.B: At once one of them ran and got a sponge. He soaked it in sour wine, put it on the end of a stick, and held it up for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to drink.
en.R: Right away one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with cheap sour wine and put it on the end of a stick. Then he held it up to Jesus's mouth so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could drink.

es.L: Y en seguida uno de ellos corrió, tomó una esponja, [la] llenó de vino agrio, [la] puso en una caña y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} daba de beber.
es.B: Al instante uno de ellos corrió a buscar una esponja. La empapó en vino agrio, la puso en la punta de una vara y la levantó para darle de beber.
es.R: Enseguida uno de ellos corrió y trajo una esponja. La llenó de vino agrio y barato y la puso en la punta de una vara. Luego la acercó a la boca de Jesús para que bebiera.

fr.L: Et aussitôt l’un d’eux courut, prit une éponge, [la] remplit de vin aigre, [la] mit au bout d’un roseau et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} donnait à boire.
fr.B: Aussitôt l’un d’eux courut prendre une éponge. Il la trempa dans du vin aigre, la fixa au bout d’un bâton et la {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} tendit pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} boive.
fr.R: Tout de suite, l’un d’eux a couru chercher une éponge. Il l’a remplie de vin aigre bon marché et l’a mise au bout d’un bâton. Puis il l’a tendue jusqu’à la bouche de Jésus pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} puisse boire.

sw.L: Na mara moja mmoja wao alikimbia, akachukua sifongo, akaijaza divai chungu, akaiweka juu ya mwanzi, akawa akimnywesha.
sw.B: Mara moja mmoja wao alikimbia, akaleta sifongo. Akailowesha katika divai chungu, akaiweka kwenye ncha ya fimbo, akamwinulia ili anywe.
sw.R: Mara moja mmoja wao alikimbia, akaleta sifongo. Akaijaza divai chungu ya bei nafuu, akaiweka kwenye ncha ya fimbo. Kisha akaiinua mpaka mdomoni mwa Yesu ili anywe.

vi.L: Và lập tức một người trong bọn họ chạy đi lấy một miếng bọt biển, nhúng đầy rượu chua, cắm vào một cây sậy, và đưa cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} uống.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, một người trong bọn họ chạy đi lấy một miếng bọt biển, nhúng đẫm rượu chua, gắn vào đầu một cây gậy và đưa lên cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} uống.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức, một người trong bọn họ chạy đi lấy một miếng bọt biển. Người ấy nhúng nó vào rượu chua rẻ tiền rồi gắn vào đầu một cây gậy. Rồi người ấy đưa lên miệng Đức Giê-xu cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} uống.

ko.L: 그러자 곧 그들 가운데 한 사람이 달려가서 해면을 가져다가 신 포도주를 적셔 갈대에 꽂아 그분께 마시게 하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그러자 곧바로 그들 가운데 한 사람이 달려가서 해면을 가져왔다. 그는 해면을 신 포도주에 적셔 갈대 막대기 끝에 꽂아 예수께 마시게 했다.
ko.R: 바로 그때 그들 가운데 한 사람이 달려가서 스펀지를 가져왔다. 그리고 그것을 값싼 신 포도주에 적셔서 막대기 끝에 꽂았다. 그리고 그것을 예수의 입에 대어 마시게 했다.

am.L: ወዲያውም ከእነርሱ አንዱ ሮጦ ሰፍነግ ወሰደ፤ በኮምጣጣ የወይን ጠጅም ሞልቶ በመቃ ላይ አድርጎ ያጠጣው ነበር።
am.B: ወዲያውም ከእነርሱ አንዱ ሮጦ ሰፍነግ አመጣ። በኮምጣጣ የወይን ጠጅ ነክሮ በበትር ጫፍ ላይ አደረገውና እንዲጠጣ ወደ እርሱ አቀረበለት።
am.R: ወዲያው ከእነርሱ አንዱ ሮጦ ሰፍነግ አመጣ። በርካሽ ኮምጣጣ የወይን ጠጅ ሞላው፤ በበትር ጫፍም ላይ አደረገው። ከዚያም እንዲጠጣ ወደ ኢየሱስ አፍ አቀረበለት።

decisions.choice: sour wine: cheap wine gone sour, a common drink
decisions.reason: Soldiers and laborers drank this sharp wine mixed with water. It eased thirst.

decisions.choice: sour wine to drink: Psalm 69:21 (69:22 in the Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: The psalm says: for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink.

decisions.choice: the drink: whether kind or cruel is not clear
decisions.reason: The man may have meant to help, or to keep Jesus alive a little longer to see if Elijah came (27:49). Matthew does not say.

decisions.choice: stick
decisions.reason: As in 27:29, Balanced and Readable say stick. Readable adds "cheap" to say what kind of wine it was.

decisions.choice: vino agrio
decisions.reason: As in John 19:29: "vinagre" today is something no one drinks; the word means cheap wine gone sour, a common drink (meaning decision m1). "Caña" and "vara" as in 27:29.

decisions.choice: divai chungu
decisions.reason: As in John 19:29: "siki" (vinegar) is something no one drinks; the word means cheap wine gone sour, a common drink (meaning decision m1). "Mwanzi" and "fimbo" as in 27:29.

decisions.choice: "rượu chua"; "cây sậy" (L), "cây gậy" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:36 and John 19:29: "giấm" today means cooking vinegar, while "rượu chua" is the soured wine the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: "신 포도주" at every level; "해면" (L, B), "스펀지" (R); "갈대" (L), "갈대 막대기" (B), "막대기" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Korean John 19:29 and Mark 15:36; "초" (vinegar) in older versions misleads, since it was cheap wine gone sour (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "ኮምጣጣ የወይን ጠጅ" (sour wine)
decisions.reason: This was cheap wine gone sour, a common drink of soldiers and labourers; "ሆምጣጤ" would suggest vinegar for cooking.

source.text: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἔλεγον· Ἄφες ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας σώσων αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: The but rest were saying, Leave, let us see whether comes Elijah saving him.

en.L: But the rest were saying, "Leave [it]; let us see whether Elijah comes to save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: But the rest told him, "Wait, let us see whether Elijah will come to save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: But the others said, "Stop! Let us wait and see if Elijah will come and save {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Pero los demás decían: «Deja, veamos si viene Elías a salvarlo».
es.B: Pero los demás le dijeron: «Espera, veamos si viene Elías a salvarlo».
es.R: Pero los otros dijeron: «¡Quieto! Vamos a esperar a ver si Elías viene a salvarlo».

fr.L: Mais les autres disaient : « Laisse ; voyons si Élie vient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver. »
fr.B: Mais les autres lui dirent : « Attends, voyons si Élie va venir {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver. »
fr.R: Mais les autres ont dit : « Arrête ! Attendons de voir si Élie va venir {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sauver. »

sw.L: Lakini wengine walikuwa wakisema, "Acha, tuone kama Eliya anakuja kumwokoa."
sw.B: Lakini wale wengine wakamwambia, "Ngoja, tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumwokoa."
sw.R: Lakini wengine wakasema, "Acha! Tusubiri tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumwokoa."

vi.L: Nhưng những người khác nói: "Hãy để yên; chúng ta xem Ê-li có đến cứu ông ấy không."
vi.B: Nhưng những người khác nói: "Khoan đã! Để xem Ê-li có đến cứu ông ấy không."
vi.R: Nhưng những người khác nói: "Thôi! Chúng ta hãy chờ xem Ê-li có đến cứu ông ấy không."

ko.L: 그러나 나머지 사람들은 말하고 있었다. "가만두어라. 엘리야가 와서 그를 구원하는지 보자."
ko.B: 그러나 다른 사람들은 "가만있어라! 엘리야가 와서 그를 구해 주나 보자" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 그러나 다른 사람들이 말했다. "그만두어라! 엘리야가 와서 그를 구해 주는지 기다려 보자."

am.L: ሌሎቹ ግን፦ «ተው፤ ኤልያስ ሊያድነው ይመጣ እንደ ሆነ እንይ» ይሉ ነበር።
am.B: ሌሎቹ ግን፦ «ቆይ፤ ኤልያስ ሊያድነው ይመጣ እንደ ሆነ እንይ» አሉት።
am.R: ሌሎቹ ግን፦ «ተው! ኤልያስ መጥቶ ያድነው እንደ ሆነ ቆይተን እንይ» አሉ።

decisions.choice: Leave: wait, hold off
decisions.reason: The word means let go or allow. Here it most likely means hold off and wait. It may also simply introduce "let us see".

decisions.choice: the SBLGNT ends the verse here
alternatives: some important early manuscripts add: and another took a spear and pierced his side, and water and blood came out
decisions.reason: Some early manuscripts, including two of the oldest complete copies of the Greek Bible, add these words, which are like John 19:34. They would place the piercing before Jesus died. Most manuscripts do not have them, and the SBLGNT leaves them out. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: to save him: the purpose of Elijah's coming
decisions.reason: The form shows purpose: whether Elijah comes in order to save him.

decisions.choice: "ông ấy" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The bystanders' own word for Jesus, as in the Vietnamese Mark 15:36; it has no capital form for the setting.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἀφῆκεν τὸ πνεῦμα.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jesus again having cried out with voice loud let go the spirit.

en.L: And Jesus cried out again with a loud voice and yielded up [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] spirit.
en.B: Once more Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} yielded up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} spirit.
en.R: Jesus shouted loudly again. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} spirit and died.

es.L: Y Jesús, clamando otra vez con gran voz, rindió [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] espíritu.
es.B: Jesús volvió a gritar con fuerte voz, y rindió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espíritu.
es.R: Jesús volvió a gritar con fuerza. Luego dejó ir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espíritu y murió.

fr.L: Et Jésus, ayant de nouveau crié d’une voix forte, rendit l’esprit.
fr.B: Jésus poussa de nouveau un grand cri et rendit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} esprit.
fr.R: Jésus a de nouveau crié très fort. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} esprit et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est mort.

sw.L: Na Yesu, akiisha kulia tena kwa sauti kuu, aliiachilia roho [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}].
sw.B: Yesu alilia tena kwa sauti kuu, akaiachilia roho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Yesu alilia tena kwa sauti kubwa. Kisha akaiachilia roho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akafa.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu lại kêu lên một tiếng lớn, và trút linh hồn [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu lại kêu lên một tiếng lớn, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trút linh hồn.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu lại kêu lên thật lớn. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trút linh hồn và qua đời.

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서는 다시 큰 소리로 외치시고 영을 떠나보내셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 다시 한번 큰 소리로 외치시고, 숨을 거두셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 다시 큰 소리로 외치셨다. 그리고 숨을 거두시고 돌아가셨다.

am.L: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ መንፈሱን ለቀቀ።
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንደገና በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ መንፈሱን አሳልፎ ሰጠ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ እንደገና ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ ጮኸ። ከዚያም መንፈሱን ሰጥቶ ሞተ።

decisions.choice: yielded up his spirit: let his spirit go, and so died
alternatives: his spirit was taken from him
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go or send away. The wording suggests that Jesus gave up his life himself rather than having it taken (compare 20:28; John 10:18). It may also be simply a way of saying he died.

decisions.choice: again: a second loud cry, after 27:46
decisions.reason: Matthew does not give the words of this cry.

decisions.choice: spirit: his life, his human spirit
decisions.reason: The word means breath, life or spirit. Here it is Jesus's own life given up in death.

decisions.choice: and died
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Jesus died.

decisions.choice: rindió (L, B); dejó ir (R); espíritu, lowercase
decisions.reason: Matthew's verb means to let go, not John's "hand over", so Spanish uses "rendir el espíritu", the phrase for yielding up one's life (meaning decision m1); Readable says "dejó ir" and adds "y murió", as the English does. "Espíritu" is lowercase because it is his own spirit (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: rendit l’esprit (L)
decisions.reason: French has the set phrase "rendre l’esprit", to die by giving up one's spirit, with the article as in the Greek, so Literal needs no supplied possessive. Balanced says "son esprit" with the span, as the English does.

decisions.choice: aliiachilia roho (let go his spirit); roho in lowercase
decisions.reason: Matthew's verb means to let go, not John's "hand over", so Swahili says "kuiachilia roho" (meaning decision m1); "kukata roho" is the everyday idiom for dying but loses the picture. "Roho" is lowercase because it is his own spirit (meaning decision m3). Readable adds "akafa" (and died), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "trút linh hồn"
alternatives: "tắt thở", as Mark 15:37, which has a different verb
decisions.reason: Matthew says that Jesus let his spirit go (meaning decision); "trút linh hồn" keeps "spirit" and is a usual Vietnamese way of saying someone died. Readable adds "qua đời", as the English Readable adds "and died".

decisions.choice: "영을 떠나보내셨다" (L); "숨을 거두셨다" (B); "숨을 거두시고 돌아가셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: He let his spirit go, and so died (meaning decision): Literal keeps the Greek picture, which shows that he gave up his life himself; Balanced uses the Korean idiom for dying of the Korean Mark 15:37, and Readable says that he died, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω εἰς δύο, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐσείσθη, καὶ αἱ πέτραι ἐσχίσθησαν, καὶ τὰ μνημεῖα ἀνεῴχθησαν καὶ πολλὰ σώματα τῶν κεκοιμημένων ἁγίων ἠγέρθησαν, καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μνημείων μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν αὐτοῦ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν καὶ ἐνεφανίσθησαν πολλοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, the curtain of the temple was torn from above to below into two, and the earth was shaken, and the rocks were split, \v 52 and the tombs were opened and many bodies of the having fallen asleep holy ones were raised, \v 53 and having come out of the tombs after the raising of him they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

en.L: And look, the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom, and the earth was shaken, and the rocks were split, \v 52 and the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the holy ones who had fallen asleep were raised, \v 53 and coming out of the tombs after {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} raising, they went into the holy city and appeared to many.
en.B: Then the temple curtain split in two, from the top all the way to the bottom. The ground shook and rocks were torn apart. \v 52 Graves were opened, and the bodies of many of God's holy people who had fallen asleep in death were raised. \v 53 Coming out of the graves after Jesus was raised, they went into the holy city and showed themselves to many people.
en.R: At that moment the curtain in the temple was torn into two pieces, from the top to the bottom. The ground shook, and rocks split apart. \v 52 Graves broke open, and many of God's people who had died were brought back to life. \v 53 They came out of their graves. After Jesus came back to life, they went into Jerusalem, the holy city, and many people saw them.

es.L: Y mira, la cortina del templo se rasgó en dos de arriba abajo, y la tierra tembló, y las rocas se partieron, \v 52 y los sepulcros se abrieron, y muchos cuerpos de los santos que habían dormido fueron resucitados, \v 53 y, saliendo de los sepulcros después de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} resurrección, entraron en la ciudad santa y se aparecieron a muchos.
es.B: Entonces la cortina del templo se rasgó en dos, de arriba abajo. La tierra tembló y las rocas se partieron. \v 52 Los sepulcros se abrieron, y los cuerpos de muchos del pueblo santo de Dios que habían dormido en la muerte fueron resucitados. \v 53 Saliendo de los sepulcros después de que Jesús fue resucitado, entraron en la ciudad santa y se mostraron a mucha gente.
es.R: En ese momento la cortina del templo se rompió en dos pedazos, de arriba abajo. La tierra tembló y las rocas se partieron. \v 52 Las tumbas se abrieron, y muchas personas del pueblo de Dios que habían muerto volvieron a la vida. \v 53 Salieron de sus tumbas. Después de que Jesús volvió a la vida, entraron en Jerusalén, la ciudad santa, y mucha gente los vio.

fr.L: Et voici, le voile du sanctuaire fut déchiré en deux, du haut jusqu’en bas, et la terre fut ébranlée, et les rochers furent fendus, \v 52 et les tombeaux furent ouverts, et beaucoup de corps des saints qui s’étaient endormis furent ressuscités, \v 53 et, sortis des tombeaux après {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} résurrection, ils entrèrent dans la ville sainte et apparurent à beaucoup.
fr.B: Alors le voile du sanctuaire se déchira en deux, de haut en bas. La terre trembla et les rochers se fendirent. \v 52 Des tombeaux s’ouvrirent, et les corps de beaucoup de membres du peuple saint de Dieu, endormis dans la mort, furent ressuscités. \v 53 Sortis des tombeaux après que Jésus fut ressuscité, ils entrèrent dans la ville sainte et se montrèrent à beaucoup de gens.
fr.R: Au même moment, le grand rideau du temple a été déchiré en deux, du haut jusqu’en bas. La terre a tremblé et des rochers se sont fendus. \v 52 Des tombeaux se sont ouverts, et beaucoup de personnes du peuple de Dieu qui étaient mortes sont revenues à la vie. \v 53 Elles sont sorties de leurs tombeaux. Après que Jésus est revenu à la vie, elles sont entrées dans Jérusalem, la ville sainte, et beaucoup de gens les ont vues.

sw.L: Na tazama, pazia la hekalu lilichanika mara mbili kutoka juu mpaka chini, na ardhi ilitikiswa, na miamba ilipasuliwa, \v 52 na makaburi yalifunguliwa, na miili mingi ya watakatifu waliokuwa wamelala ilifufuliwa, \v 53 na wakitoka makaburini baada ya kufufuliwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, waliingia katika mji ule mtakatifu na kuonekana kwa wengi.
sw.B: Kisha pazia la hekalu lilichanika vipande viwili, kuanzia juu kabisa hadi chini. Ardhi ikatikisika na miamba ikapasuka. \v 52 Makaburi yakafunguka, na miili ya watu wengi watakatifu wa Mungu waliokuwa wamelala katika kifo ikafufuliwa. \v 53 Wakitoka makaburini baada ya Yesu kufufuliwa, waliingia katika mji mtakatifu, wakajionyesha kwa watu wengi.
sw.R: Wakati huo huo pazia la hekalu lilichanika vipande viwili, kutoka juu mpaka chini. Ardhi ikatetemeka, na miamba ikapasuka. \v 52 Makaburi yakafunguka, na watu wengi wa Mungu waliokuwa wamekufa wakawa hai tena. \v 53 Wakatoka makaburini mwao. Baada ya Yesu kuwa hai tena, waliingia Yerusalemu, mji mtakatifu, na watu wengi wakawaona.

vi.L: Và kìa, bức màn của đền thờ bị xé làm đôi từ trên xuống dưới, và đất rúng động, và các tảng đá bị vỡ ra, \v 52 và các mộ mở ra, và nhiều thân thể của các thánh đồ đã ngủ được sống lại, \v 53 và ra khỏi mộ, sau khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại, họ vào thành thánh và hiện ra cho nhiều người.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, bức màn trong đền thờ bị xé ra làm hai, từ trên xuống dưới. Đất rúng động và các tảng đá vỡ ra. \v 52 Các mộ mở ra, và thân thể của nhiều người thánh của Đức Chúa Trời đã an giấc được sống lại. \v 53 Sau khi Đức Giê-xu sống lại, họ ra khỏi mộ, vào thành thánh và hiện ra cho nhiều người thấy.
vi.R: Ngay lúc ấy, bức màn trong đền thờ bị xé làm hai mảnh, từ trên xuống tận dưới. Đất rung chuyển, và các tảng đá vỡ ra. \v 52 Các ngôi mộ mở ra, và nhiều người thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời đã chết được sống lại. \v 53 Họ ra khỏi mộ. Sau khi Đức Giê-xu sống lại, họ vào Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành thánh, và nhiều người đã thấy họ.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 성소의 휘장이 위에서부터 아래까지 두 갈래로 찢어졌다. 그리고 땅이 흔들리고 바위들이 갈라졌다. \v 52 그리고 무덤들이 열리고, 잠든 성도들의 몸이 많이 살아났다. \v 53 그리고 그들은 그분의 부활 후에 무덤에서 나와 거룩한 성에 들어가서 많은 사람에게 나타났다.
ko.B: 그때 성소의 휘장이 위에서 아래까지 둘로 찢어졌다. 땅이 흔들리고 바위들이 갈라졌다. \v 52 무덤들이 열리고, 잠들어 있던 하나님의 거룩한 백성 가운데 많은 사람의 몸이 살아났다. \v 53 그들은 예수께서 살아나신 뒤에 무덤에서 나와 거룩한 도성에 들어가서, 많은 사람에게 나타났다.
ko.R: 바로 그때 성전 안에 드리워져 있던 휘장이 위에서부터 아래까지 두 쪽으로 찢어졌다. 땅이 흔들리고 바위들이 갈라졌다. \v 52 무덤들이 열리고, 죽었던 하나님의 백성 가운데 많은 사람이 다시 살아났다. \v 53 그들은 무덤에서 나왔다. 그리고 예수께서 다시 살아나신 뒤에 거룩한 도성 예루살렘에 들어갔다. 많은 사람이 그들을 보았다.

am.L: እነሆም፣ የቤተ መቅደሱ መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ለሁለት ተቀደደ፤ ምድርም ተናወጠች፤ ዓለቶችም ተሰነጠቁ፤ \v 52 መቃብሮችም ተከፈቱ፤ አንቀላፍተው የነበሩ የብዙ ቅዱሳን አካላትም ተነሡ፤ \v 53 ከእርሱም ትንሣኤ በኋላ ከመቃብሮች ወጥተው ወደ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ገቡ፤ ለብዙዎችም ታዩ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ የቤተ መቅደሱ መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ድረስ ለሁለት ተቀደደ። ምድር ተናወጠች፤ ዓለቶችም ተሰነጣጠቁ። \v 52 መቃብሮች ተከፈቱ፤ በሞት አንቀላፍተው የነበሩ የብዙ የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱሳን ሰዎች አካላትም ተነሡ። \v 53 ኢየሱስ ከሞት ከተነሣ በኋላ ከመቃብሮቹ ወጥተው ወደ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ገቡ፤ ለብዙ ሰዎችም ተገለጡ።
am.R: በዚያው ቅጽበት በቤተ መቅደሱ ውስጥ ያለው መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ለሁለት ተቀደደ። ምድር ተናወጠች፤ ዓለቶችም ተሰነጠቁ። \v 52 መቃብሮች ተከፈቱ፤ ሞተው የነበሩ ብዙ የእግዚአብሔር ሰዎችም ወደ ሕይወት ተመለሱ። \v 53 ከመቃብራቸውም ወጡ። ኢየሱስ ከሞት ከተነሣ በኋላ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ወደ ሆነችው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ገቡ፤ ብዙ ሰዎችም አዩአቸው።

decisions.choice: the curtain of the temple: most likely the inner curtain before the Most Holy Place
alternatives: the outer curtain at the entrance
decisions.reason: The sanctuary had two great curtains. The inner one closed off the Most Holy Place, where only the high priest went once a year (Exodus 26:31-33; Hebrews 10:19-20). The outer one hung at the entrance. Matthew does not say which, or explain the sign; the passive and "from top to bottom" point to God as the one who tore it.

decisions.choice: after his raising: with coming out, or with entering the city
alternatives: the holy ones came out after Jesus rose
they came out at his death and entered the city after he rose
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between "coming out of the tombs" and "went into the holy city" and may belong with either. Either way, Jesus is the first to rise (1 Corinthians 15:20).

decisions.choice: the holy ones who had fallen asleep: faithful people of God who had died
decisions.reason: Sleep is a picture of death for those who will rise (Daniel 12:2; 1 Thessalonians 4:13-14). Ezekiel 37:12-13 pictures God opening his people's graves. Matthew does not say who these were or what became of them.

decisions.choice: the holy city: Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Matthew called Jerusalem the holy city in 4:5.

decisions.choice: look (L); at that moment (R); then (B) (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: after Jesus was raised (B); after Jesus came back to life (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus and use a verb instead of the noun. Readable names Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: los santos (L); el pueblo santo de Dios (B); el pueblo de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for the saints in the New Testament: today "santos" suggests canonized saints, so Balanced and Readable say whom the word means, faithful people of God who had died (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: sepulcros (L, B); tumbas (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for a tomb throughout the New Testament: "sepulcro" at Literal and Balanced, the everyday "tumba" at Readable. The same in 27:60-61 and 28:1-8.

decisions.choice: le voile du sanctuaire (L, B); le grand rideau du temple (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as Mark 15:38 and Luke 23:45 in French, so that the three accounts read alike. "Sanctuaire" says that the curtain hung in the temple building itself (m1); Readable uses everyday words.

decisions.choice: les saints (L); membres du peuple saint de Dieu (B); personnes du peuple de Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: As the New Testament term sheet sets: "les saints" at Literal, God's holy people at Balanced and Readable, since "saints" in French suggests people the Church has declared saints.

decisions.choice: watakatifu (L); watu watakatifu wa Mungu (B); watu wa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for the saints in the New Testament: Balanced and Readable say whom the word means, faithful people of God who had died (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: passive verbs at Literal (ilitikiswa, ilipasuliwa, yalifunguliwa, ilifufuliwa)
alternatives: the stative forms of Balanced (ikatikisika, ikapasuka, yakafunguka)
decisions.reason: Every verb in the Greek list is passive, which can point to God as the one who acts; Literal keeps the passives, Balanced and Readable use the forms Swahili uses for what happens to the earth, rocks and graves. "Kufufuliwa" (be raised) stays passive at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "bức màn của đền thờ"; "đền thờ" for naos
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:38; the meaning decision says which curtain is meant.

decisions.choice: "các thánh đồ đã ngủ" (L); "người thánh của Đức Chúa Trời đã an giấc" (B); "người thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời đã chết" (R)
decisions.reason: Faithful people of God who had died (meaning decision): Literal keeps the picture of sleep, Balanced uses the gentle "an giấc", and Readable says plainly that they had died.

decisions.choice: "성소의 휘장" (L, B); "성전 안에 드리워져 있던 휘장" (R)
decisions.reason: The inner curtain of the sanctuary (meaning decision), in the words of the Korean Mark 15:38.

decisions.choice: "잠든 성도들" (L); "잠들어 있던 하나님의 거룩한 백성" (B); "죽었던 하나님의 백성" (R); "살아나다" for egeiro
decisions.reason: Faithful people of God who had died (meaning decision); Korean has no natural passive of "raise", so the intransitive "살아나다" is used, as in the Korean Mark 16:6. Literal keeps "after his raising" placed so that it can go with coming out or with entering the city (meaning decision).

source.text: Ὁ δὲ ἑκατόνταρχος καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ τηροῦντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδόντες τὸν σεισμὸν καὶ τὰ γενόμενα ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα λέγοντες· Ἀληθῶς θεοῦ υἱὸς ἦν οὗτος.

records.literal_gloss: The but centurion and those with him keeping watch over the Jesus having seen the earthquake and the things happening feared greatly saying, Truly God's Son was this.

en.L: And when the centurion and those with him who were keeping watch over Jesus saw the earthquake and the things that were happening, they were greatly afraid, saying, "Truly this was God's Son!"
en.B: The centurion and the men with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and everything that was happening, and they were filled with fear. "This man truly was God's Son!" they said.
en.R: The Roman army officer and the soldiers with him were guarding Jesus. They saw the earthquake and everything else that happened, and they were very afraid. They said, "This man really was God's Son!"

es.L: Y el centurión y los que con él custodiaban a Jesús, al ver el terremoto y las cosas que sucedían, tuvieron mucho miedo, diciendo: «Verdaderamente este era Hijo de Dios».
es.B: El centurión y los hombres que con él vigilaban a Jesús vieron el terremoto y todo lo que estaba pasando, y se llenaron de temor. «¡De verdad este hombre era Hijo de Dios!», dijeron.
es.R: El oficial romano y los soldados que estaban con él vigilaban a Jesús. Vieron el terremoto y todo lo demás que pasó, y tuvieron mucho miedo. Dijeron: «¡De veras este hombre era Hijo de Dios!».

fr.L: Et le centurion et ceux qui gardaient Jésus avec lui, ayant vu le tremblement de terre et ce qui arrivait, furent saisis d’une grande crainte et dirent : « Vraiment, celui-ci était Fils de Dieu ! »
fr.B: Le centurion et les hommes qui gardaient Jésus avec lui virent le tremblement de terre et tout ce qui se passait, et ils furent remplis de crainte. « Cet homme était vraiment Fils de Dieu ! » dirent-ils.
fr.R: L’officier de l’armée romaine et les soldats qui étaient avec lui gardaient Jésus. Ils ont vu le tremblement de terre et tout ce qui s’était passé, et ils ont eu très peur. Ils ont dit : « Cet homme était vraiment Fils de Dieu ! »

sw.L: Na akida, pamoja na wale waliokuwa wakimlinda Yesu pamoja naye, walipoona tetemeko la ardhi na mambo yaliyokuwa yakitukia, waliingiwa na hofu kuu, wakisema, "Kwa kweli huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!"
sw.B: Akida na askari waliokuwa pamoja naye wakimlinda Yesu waliona tetemeko la ardhi na yote yaliyokuwa yakitukia, wakajaa hofu. Wakasema, "Kwa kweli mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!"
sw.R: Afisa wa jeshi la Kirumi na askari waliokuwa pamoja naye walikuwa wakimlinda Yesu. Waliona tetemeko la ardhi na mambo mengine yote yaliyotukia, wakaogopa sana. Wakasema, "Ni kweli! Mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!"

vi.L: Còn viên đội trưởng và những người cùng với ông canh giữ Đức Giê-xu, thấy cơn động đất và những việc đã xảy ra, thì vô cùng sợ hãi và nói: "Thật, người này là Con Đức Chúa Trời!"
vi.B: Viên đội trưởng và những người lính cùng ông canh giữ Đức Giê-xu thấy cơn động đất và mọi việc vừa xảy ra thì rất kinh hãi. Họ nói: "Người này thật là Con Đức Chúa Trời!"
vi.R: Viên sĩ quan La Mã và những người lính cùng với ông đang canh giữ Đức Giê-xu. Họ thấy cơn động đất và mọi điều khác đã xảy ra, và họ rất sợ hãi. Họ nói: "Người này đúng thật là Con Đức Chúa Trời!"

ko.L: 그런데 백부장과 그와 함께 예수를 지키던 사람들이 지진과 일어난 일들을 보고 몹시 두려워하며 말했다. "참으로 이 사람은 하나님의 아들이었다!"
ko.B: 백부장과 그와 함께 예수를 지키던 병사들은 지진과 그 밖에 일어난 모든 일을 보고 몹시 두려워하며 말했다. "이분은 참으로 하나님의 아들이셨다!"
ko.R: 로마 군대의 장교와 그와 함께 있던 병사들이 예수를 지키고 있었다. 그들은 지진과 그 밖에 일어난 모든 일을 보고 몹시 무서워했다. 그들이 말했다. "이분은 정말 하나님의 아들이셨다!"

am.L: የመቶ አለቃውና ከእርሱ ጋር ኢየሱስን ይጠብቁ የነበሩት የምድሩን መናወጥና የሆነውን ነገር ባዩ ጊዜ እጅግ ፈርተው፦ «በእውነት ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበር!» አሉ።
am.B: የመቶ አለቃውና ከእርሱ ጋር ኢየሱስን ይጠብቁ የነበሩት ሰዎች የምድሩን መናወጥና የሆነውን ሁሉ አዩ፤ በፍርሀትም ተሞሉ። «ይህ ሰው በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበር!» አሉ።
am.R: የሮማውያን ወታደሮች አለቃና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ወታደሮች ኢየሱስን ይጠብቁ ነበር። የምድሩን መናወጥና የሆነውን ሌላውን ነገር ሁሉ አዩ፤ በጣምም ፈሩ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ይህ ሰው በእርግጥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበር!»

decisions.choice: God's Son: the Son of God
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article, so it could mean "a son of God" or, from Gentiles, "a son of a god". But a title placed before the verb often lacks the article and is still definite, and the words answer the mockers' "if you are the Son of God" (27:40, 43). The disciples said the same words in 14:33. What the soldiers themselves understood is less certain.

decisions.choice: centurion: a Roman officer over about a hundred soldiers
decisions.reason: He was in charge of the execution, like the centurion of 8:5 a Gentile.

decisions.choice: greatly afraid: struck with awe
decisions.reason: The fear comes from seeing God at work, as with the disciples in 17:6.

decisions.choice: God's Son
decisions.reason: All levels say "God's Son", which keeps the openness of the Greek. Readable says "Roman army officer" for centurion, as in 8:5.

decisions.choice: Hijo de Dios, without the article
decisions.reason: As the English "God's Son" (rendering decision r-en-1): Spanish without the article keeps the open question of meaning decision m1; "el Hijo de Dios" would settle it. "Él" here is the centurion and takes no setting.

decisions.choice: Fils de Dieu, without an article, at every level; le centurion (L, B), l’officier de l’armée romaine (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 15:39 in French: with no article the words keep the openness of the Greek (m1), as the English "God's Son" does, while the capital marks what Matthew means by them. Readable names the centurion as the English does.

decisions.choice: "viên đội trưởng" (L, B); "viên sĩ quan La Mã" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:39: "thầy đội" now sounds dated and "bách quản" is a calque few readers know; Readable says plainly who he was.

decisions.choice: "người này" in the soldiers' words
decisions.reason: The soldiers speak of Jesus as a man they have just seen die; "người này" is respectful and has no capital form for the setting.

decisions.choice: "백부장" (L, B), "로마 군대의 장교" (R); "이 사람은 ... 이었다" (L), "이분은 ... 이셨다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 15:39: Literal keeps the Greek "this man"; in Balanced and Readable the confession would sound grudging in Korean without the honorific.

decisions.choice: "የመቶ አለቃ" (L, B); "የሮማውያን ወታደሮች አለቃ" (R)
decisions.reason: "የመቶ አለቃ", "commander of a hundred", says exactly what a centurion was; Readable names him as an officer of the Roman army, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ γυναῖκες πολλαὶ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι, αἵτινες ἠκολούθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας διακονοῦσαι αὐτῷ·

records.literal_gloss: Were then there women many from afar watching, who followed the Jesus from the Galilee serving him;

en.L: And many women were there, watching from a distance, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}};
en.B: A number of women stood watching from far off. These women had come with Jesus all the way from Galilee, providing for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Many women were there too. They watched from far away. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to help {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and take care of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y había allí muchas mujeres mirando desde lejos, las cuales habían seguido a Jesús desde Galilea, sirviéndole;
es.B: Había también muchas mujeres que miraban desde lejos. Ellas habían acompañado a Jesús desde Galilea y se ocupaban de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} necesidades.
es.R: Allí había también muchas mujeres. Miraban desde lejos. Habían seguido a Jesús desde Galilea para ayudarlo y cuidarlo.

fr.L: Or il y avait là beaucoup de femmes qui regardaient de loin, elles qui avaient suivi Jésus depuis la Galilée en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servant ;
fr.B: Beaucoup de femmes étaient là aussi, qui regardaient de loin. Elles avaient accompagné Jésus depuis la Galilée et pourvoyaient à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} besoins.
fr.R: Beaucoup de femmes étaient là aussi. Elles regardaient de loin. Elles avaient suivi Jésus depuis la Galilée pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aider et s’occuper de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Na pale walikuwepo wanawake wengi waliokuwa wakiangalia kutoka mbali; hao walikuwa wamefuatana na Yesu tangu Galilaya, wakimtumikia;
sw.B: Wanawake wengi walikuwa pale wakiangalia kutoka mbali. Wanawake hao walikuwa wamefuatana na Yesu tangu Galilaya, wakimpatia mahitaji {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Wanawake wengi pia walikuwa pale. Waliangalia kutoka mbali. Walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu tangu Galilaya ili kumsaidia na kumtunza.

vi.L: Vả, có nhiều người phụ nữ ở đó đứng xem từ xa, là những người đã đi theo Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê để phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}};
vi.B: Cũng có nhiều phụ nữ đứng nhìn từ xa. Những người này đã đi theo Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê để lo cho các nhu cầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Cũng có nhiều phụ nữ ở đó. Họ đứng nhìn từ xa. Họ đã đi theo Đức Giê-xu từ Ga-li-lê để giúp đỡ và chăm lo cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그런데 거기에 많은 여자가 멀리서 지켜보고 있었다. 그들은 갈릴리에서부터 예수를 따라오며 그분을 섬기던 여자들이었다.
ko.B: 또 많은 여자가 멀리서 지켜보고 있었다. 그들은 갈릴리에서부터 예수를 따라오며 시중들던 여자들이었다.
ko.R: 여자들도 많이 거기 있었다. 그들은 멀리서 지켜보았다. 그들은 갈릴리에서부터 예수를 따라와서 예수께 필요한 것을 돌보아 드렸다.

am.L: በዚያም ኢየሱስን እያገለገሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ብዙ ሴቶች ከሩቅ ሆነው ይመለከቱ ነበር፤
am.B: ብዙ ሴቶችም ከሩቅ ቆመው ይመለከቱ ነበር። እነዚህ ሴቶች የሚያስፈልገውን እያሟሉለት ከገሊላ ጀምሮ ኢየሱስን የተከተሉ ነበሩ።
am.R: ብዙ ሴቶችም በዚያ ነበሩ። ከሩቅ ሆነው ይመለከቱ ነበር። እነርሱም ኢየሱስን ለመርዳትና ለመንከባከብ ከገሊላ ጀምሮ ተከትለውት ነበር።

decisions.choice: serving him: providing for his needs
decisions.reason: The verb means to serve or wait on. Luke 8:3 says such women provided for Jesus from their own means.

decisions.choice: the women stayed when the disciples fled
decisions.reason: All the disciples had left him and fled (26:56). The women watch his death, his burial (27:61) and the empty tomb (28:1).

decisions.choice: from a distance: perhaps Psalm 38:11 (38:12 in the Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: The psalm says that friends and neighbors stand far off. Matthew does not cite it.

decisions.choice: "섬기다" (L); "시중들다" (B); "필요한 것을 돌보아 드리다" (R) for diakoneo
decisions.reason: Providing for his needs (meaning decision), in the words of the Korean Mark 15:41.

source.text: ἐν αἷς ἦν Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσὴφ μήτηρ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ τῶν υἱῶν Ζεβεδαίου.

records.literal_gloss: among whom was Mary the Magdalene and Mary the of James and Joseph mother and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

en.L: among whom were Mary the Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
en.B: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.
en.R: Mary from the town of Magdala was there. So was Mary, the mother of James and Joseph. The mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee, was there too.

es.L: entre las cuales estaban María la Magdalena, y María la madre de Santiago y de José, y la madre de los hijos de Zebedeo.
es.B: Entre ellas estaban María Magdalena, María la madre de Santiago y de José, y la madre de los hijos de Zebedeo.
es.R: Allí estaba María, la del pueblo de Magdala. También estaba María, la madre de Santiago y de José. Y estaba la madre de Santiago y Juan, los hijos de Zebedeo.

fr.L: parmi lesquelles étaient Marie la Magdaléenne, et Marie, la mère de Jacques et de Joseph, et la mère des fils de Zébédée.
fr.B: Parmi elles se trouvaient Marie de Magdala, Marie, mère de Jacques et de Joseph, et la mère des fils de Zébédée.
fr.R: Marie, de la ville de Magdala, était là. Il y avait aussi Marie, la mère de Jacques et de Joseph. La mère de Jacques et de Jean, les fils de Zébédée, était là, elle aussi.

sw.L: miongoni mwao alikuwa Mariamu Magdalene, na Mariamu mama wa Yakobo na Yosefu, na mama wa wana wa Zebedayo.
sw.B: Miongoni mwao walikuwa Mariamu Magdalene, Mariamu mama wa Yakobo na Yosefu, na mama wa wana wa Zebedayo.
sw.R: Mariamu wa mji wa Magdala alikuwa pale. Mariamu mama wa Yakobo na Yosefu alikuwa pale pia. Mama wa Yakobo na Yohana, wana wa Zebedayo, naye alikuwa pale.

vi.L: trong số đó có Ma-ri Ma-đơ-len, Ma-ri mẹ của Gia-cơ và Giô-sép, và mẹ của các con trai Xê-bê-đê.
vi.B: Trong số đó có Ma-ri Ma-đơ-len, Ma-ri mẹ của Gia-cơ và Giô-sép, và mẹ của các con trai Xê-bê-đê.
vi.R: Có Ma-ri, người làng Ma-đơ-la. Có một bà Ma-ri khác, là mẹ của Gia-cơ và Giô-sép. Mẹ của Gia-cơ và Giăng, hai con trai ông Xê-bê-đê, cũng có ở đó.

ko.L: 그 가운데는 막달라 [여자] 마리아와 야고보와 요셉의 어머니 마리아와 세베대의 아들들의 어머니가 있었다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데는 막달라 마리아와 야고보와 요셉의 어머니 마리아와 세베대의 아들들의 어머니가 있었다.
ko.R: 막달라라는 마을에서 온 마리아가 거기 있었다. 야고보와 요셉의 어머니 마리아도 있었다. 세베대의 아들들인 야고보와 요한의 어머니도 거기 있었다.

am.L: ከእነርሱም መካከል መግደላዊት ማርያም፣ የያዕቆብና የዮሴፍ እናት ማርያም፣ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች እናትም ነበሩ።
am.B: በመካከላቸውም መግደላዊት ማርያም፣ የያዕቆብና የዮሴፍ እናት ማርያም፣ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች እናትም ነበሩ።
am.R: ከመቅደላ ከተማ የሆነችው ማርያም በዚያ ነበረች። የያዕቆብና የዮሴፍ እናት ማርያምም ነበረች። የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች የያዕቆብና የዮሐንስ እናትም በዚያ ነበረች።

decisions.choice: Mary the Magdalene: Mary from Magdala
decisions.reason: Magdala was a town on the west shore of the Sea of Galilee. Luke 8:2 says seven demons had gone out of her.

decisions.choice: Mary the mother of James and Joseph: most likely not Jesus's mother
decisions.reason: Jesus had brothers named James and Joseph (13:55), but Matthew would hardly name Jesus's mother this way here. Mark 15:40 calls this Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses.

decisions.choice: the mother of Zebedee's sons: the mother of James and John
decisions.reason: She asked Jesus for places at his right and left (20:20-21). Mark 15:40 names a Salome among the women; she may be the same person.

decisions.choice: from the town of Magdala; James and John
alternatives: the Magdalene; the sons of Zebedee
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name and names the sons of Zebedee (4:21).

decisions.choice: Marie la Magdaléenne (L); Marie de Magdala (B, R) (for the whole of Matthew 27-28)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 15-16 and Luke 24 in French. Literal keeps the Greek adjective; Balanced and Readable name her town, which is what the word means (m1). "Marie-Madeleine" is the church name and hides the place.

decisions.choice: "Ma-ri Ma-đơ-len" (L, B); "Ma-ri, người làng Ma-đơ-la" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 15:40 and John 19:25: the familiar byname at Literal and Balanced; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "막달라 마리아" at every level, with [여자] at Literal; "요셉" for Ioseph
decisions.reason: The established Protestant form (style guide, section 5); Literal brackets what Korean adds to the Greek "the Magdalene". Matthew's spelling here is Joseph, where Mark has Joses.

source.text: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἦλθεν ἄνθρωπος πλούσιος ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας, τοὔνομα Ἰωσήφ, ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἐμαθητεύθη τῷ Ἰησοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Evening then having come came a man rich from Arimathea, the name Joseph, who also himself was discipled to the Jesus;

en.L: And when evening had come, a rich man from Arimathea came, named Joseph, who himself also had become a disciple of Jesus;
en.B: As evening came on, Joseph arrived, a rich man from the town of Arimathea who had also become one of Jesus's disciples.
en.R: That evening a rich man named Joseph came. He was from the town of Arimathea. He had also become a follower of Jesus.

es.L: Y, llegada la tarde, vino un hombre rico de Arimatea, llamado José, que también él mismo se había hecho discípulo de Jesús;
es.B: Al caer la tarde llegó José, un hombre rico del pueblo de Arimatea, que también se había hecho discípulo de Jesús.
es.R: Esa tarde llegó un hombre rico llamado José. Era del pueblo de Arimatea. Él también se había hecho seguidor de Jesús.

fr.L: Or, le soir étant venu, vint un homme riche d’Arimathée, nommé Joseph, qui était lui aussi devenu disciple de Jésus ;
fr.B: Le soir venu, arriva Joseph, un homme riche de la ville d’Arimathée, qui était lui aussi devenu disciple de Jésus.
fr.R: Ce soir-là, un homme riche appelé Joseph est arrivé. Il venait de la ville d’Arimathée. Lui aussi était devenu disciple de Jésus.

sw.L: Na ilipofika jioni, alikuja mtu tajiri kutoka Arimathaya, jina lake Yosefu, ambaye yeye mwenyewe pia alikuwa amekuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu;
sw.B: Ilipokaribia jioni, Yosefu alifika. Alikuwa mtu tajiri wa mji wa Arimathaya, naye pia alikuwa amekuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.
sw.R: Jioni ile mtu mmoja tajiri aitwaye Yosefu alikuja. Alikuwa wa mji wa Arimathaya. Yeye pia alikuwa amekuwa mfuasi wa Yesu.

vi.L: Vả, khi chiều đến, có một người giàu từ A-ri-ma-thê đến, tên là Giô-sép, chính ông cũng đã trở thành môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu;
vi.B: Khi trời đã về chiều, có một người giàu có tên là Giô-sép, người thành A-ri-ma-thê, đến. Ông cũng đã trở thành môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Chiều hôm ấy, có một người giàu tên là Giô-sép đến. Ông là người thành A-ri-ma-thê. Ông cũng đã trở thành môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 저녁이 되었을 때, 아리마대 출신의 부자 한 사람이 왔는데, 이름은 요셉이었다. 그도 예수의 제자가 된 사람이었다.
ko.B: 날이 저물어 갈 무렵에 아리마대 출신의 부자 요셉이 왔다. 그도 예수의 제자가 된 사람이었다.
ko.R: 그날 저녁에 요셉이라는 부자가 왔다. 그는 아리마대라는 마을에서 온 사람이었다. 요셉도 예수의 제자가 되어 있었다.

am.L: በመሸም ጊዜ ዮሴፍ የሚባል ከአርማትያስ የሆነ አንድ ሀብታም ሰው መጣ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ራሱ የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር ሆኖ ነበር፤
am.B: ምሽት ሲቃረብም ከአርማትያስ ከተማ የሆነ ዮሴፍ የሚባል አንድ ሀብታም ሰው መጣ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ከኢየሱስ ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዱ ሆኖ ነበር።
am.R: በዚያ ምሽት ዮሴፍ የሚባል አንድ ሀብታም ሰው መጣ። እርሱም ከአርማትያስ ከተማ ነበር። እርሱም ደግሞ የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር ሆኖ ነበር።

decisions.choice: evening: the late afternoon before sunset, with the Sabbath near
decisions.reason: The law said a body hanged on a tree must not stay there overnight (Deuteronomy 21:22-23), and the Sabbath began at sunset (27:62).

decisions.choice: Arimathea: a town in Judea
decisions.reason: Luke 23:51 calls it a town of the Jews. Its exact location is not certain.

decisions.choice: a rich man: perhaps Isaiah 53:9
decisions.reason: The servant in Isaiah 53:9 is with a rich man in his death. Matthew does not cite the verse.

decisions.choice: had become a disciple: had been taught by Jesus and followed him
decisions.reason: The verb means to be made a disciple (28:19). John 19:38 says Joseph followed Jesus in secret.

decisions.choice: follower
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for disciple, as elsewhere in Matthew.

decisions.choice: disciple at Readable too (also 28:7-8, 28:13, 28:16)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Matthew in French: "disciple" is a common French word, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "follower".

decisions.choice: "môn đồ" at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "môn đồ" at every level; it is a plain, familiar word. "Giô-sép người A-ri-ma-thê" as in the Vietnamese Mark 15:43.

decisions.choice: "아리마대"; "제자" at every level for matheteuo
decisions.reason: The Protestant name form of the Korean Mark 15:43; "제자" at every level, as the Korean Gospels settle for disciples.

decisions.choice: "ደቀ መዝሙር" (disciple) at Readable too
decisions.reason: "ደቀ መዝሙር" is the everyday Amharic word for a disciple and is kept at every level through Matthew, where the English Readable says "follower".

source.text: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: This one having gone to the Pilate asked for the body of the Jesus.

en.L: He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
en.B: He went to Pilate and requested Jesus's body.
en.R: Joseph went to Pilate and asked him for Jesus's body.

es.L: Este, acercándose a Pilato, pidió el cuerpo de Jesús.
es.B: Fue a ver a Pilato y le pidió el cuerpo de Jesús.
es.R: José fue a ver a Pilato y le pidió el cuerpo de Jesús.

fr.L: Celui-ci alla trouver Pilate et demanda le corps de Jésus.
fr.B: Il se rendit auprès de Pilate et lui demanda le corps de Jésus.
fr.R: Joseph est allé voir Pilate et lui a demandé le corps de Jésus.

sw.L: Huyu, akiwa amemwendea Pilato, aliuomba mwili wa Yesu.
sw.B: Alikwenda kwa Pilato, akaomba mwili wa Yesu.
sw.R: Yosefu alikwenda kwa Pilato, akamwomba ampe mwili wa Yesu.

vi.L: Ông này đến gặp Phi-lát và xin thi thể của Đức Giê-xu.
vi.B: Ông đến gặp Phi-lát và xin thi thể của Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Giô-sép đến gặp Phi-lát và xin ông cho mình lấy thi thể của Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 이 사람이 빌라도에게 가서 예수의 시신을 달라고 청했다.
ko.B: 그는 빌라도에게 가서 예수의 시신을 내어 달라고 청했다.
ko.R: 요셉은 빌라도에게 가서 예수의 시신을 달라고 부탁했다.

am.L: እርሱም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነ።
am.B: እርሱም ወደ ጲላጦስ ሄዶ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ጠየቀ።
am.R: ዮሴፍ ወደ ጲላጦስ ሄዶ የኢየሱስን አስከሬን እንዲሰጠው ለመነው።

decisions.choice: asked for the body: permission was needed
alternatives: the body would have been given anyway
decisions.reason: Romans often left the bodies of the crucified on the cross or threw them in a common grave. To ask for the body of a man executed for rebellion took courage (Mark 15:43).

decisions.choice: Joseph
decisions.reason: Readable names Joseph.

decisions.choice: "시신" for soma, the body of Jesus, at every level, through 27:59
decisions.reason: The respectful word of the Korean John 19:38 and Mark 15:43.

decisions.choice: "ሥጋ" (body) (L, B); "አስከሬን" (dead body) (R)
decisions.reason: "ሥጋ" is the word for the body of Jesus in Amharic Christian speech; Readable uses the everyday word for a dead person's body.

source.text: τότε ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐκέλευσεν ἀποδοθῆναι.

records.literal_gloss: Then the Pilate ordered to be given.

en.L: Then Pilate ordered [it] to be given [to him].
en.B: Pilate then ordered that it be handed over to him.
en.R: Pilate gave orders for the body to be given to Joseph.

es.L: Entonces Pilato ordenó que [le] fuera entregado.
es.B: Entonces Pilato ordenó que se lo entregaran.
es.R: Pilato ordenó que le dieran el cuerpo a José.

fr.L: Alors Pilate ordonna qu’[il lui] soit remis.
fr.B: Pilate ordonna alors qu’on le lui remette.
fr.R: Pilate a donné l’ordre de donner le corps à Joseph.

sw.L: Ndipo Pilato aliamuru utolewe [kwake].
sw.B: Ndipo Pilato akaamuru akabidhiwe.
sw.R: Pilato akaagiza Yosefu apewe mwili huo.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Phi-lát ra lệnh giao [thi thể cho ông].
vi.B: Phi-lát liền ra lệnh giao thi thể cho ông.
vi.R: Phi-lát ra lệnh giao thi thể cho Giô-sép.

ko.L: 그때 빌라도가 [그것을 그에게] 내주라고 명령했다.
ko.B: 그러자 빌라도는 시신을 그에게 내주라고 명령했다.
ko.R: 빌라도는 예수의 시신을 요셉에게 내주라고 명령했다.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ጲላጦስ [ለእርሱ] እንዲሰጥ አዘዘ።
am.B: ጲላጦስም ለእርሱ እንዲሰጠው አዘዘ።
am.R: ጲላጦስም አስከሬኑ ለዮሴፍ እንዲሰጠው አዘዘ።

decisions.choice: to be given: to be handed over to Joseph
alternatives: to be given back to the family
decisions.reason: The verb means to give over or give back. Pilate releases the body to Joseph.

decisions.choice: the body; to Joseph
decisions.reason: Readable says what was given and to whom.

decisions.choice: [그것을 그에게] (L)
decisions.reason: Korean "내주다" needs what is given and to whom; the English Literal brackets them too.

source.text: καὶ λαβὼν τὸ σῶμα ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ σινδόνι καθαρᾷ, καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸ ἐν τῷ καινῷ αὐτοῦ μνημείῳ ὃ ἐλατόμησεν ἐν τῇ πέτρᾳ, καὶ προσκυλίσας λίθον μέγαν τῇ θύρᾳ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπῆλθεν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken the body the Joseph wrapped it in a linen cloth clean, \v 60 and placed it in the new of him tomb which he had hewn in the rock, and having rolled a stone great to the door of the tomb he went away.

en.L: And Joseph took the body and wrapped it in clean linen cloth \v 60 and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock; and having rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, he went away.
en.B: Joseph took the body and wound a clean linen sheet around it. \v 60 Then he placed it in the new tomb he had carved in the rock for himself, rolled a great stone across the doorway of the tomb, and went away.
en.R: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean cloth made of linen. \v 60 He put the body in his own new tomb, which had been cut into the rock. Then he rolled a big stone in front of the opening to close the tomb, and he went away.

es.L: Y José, tomando el cuerpo, lo envolvió en una sábana limpia de lino, \v 60 y lo puso en su sepulcro nuevo, que había excavado en la roca; y, haciendo rodar una gran piedra a la puerta del sepulcro, se fue.
es.B: José tomó el cuerpo y lo envolvió en una sábana limpia de lino. \v 60 Luego lo puso en el sepulcro nuevo que se había hecho labrar en la roca, hizo rodar una gran piedra hasta tapar la entrada del sepulcro y se fue.
es.R: José tomó el cuerpo y lo envolvió en una tela limpia de lino. \v 60 Puso el cuerpo en su propia tumba nueva, que estaba cavada en la roca. Después hizo rodar una piedra grande delante de la entrada para cerrar la tumba, y se fue.

fr.L: Et Joseph, ayant pris le corps, l’enveloppa dans un drap de lin propre \v 60 et le déposa dans son tombeau neuf, qu’il avait taillé dans le roc ; et, ayant roulé une grande pierre contre la porte du tombeau, il s’en alla.
fr.B: Joseph prit le corps et l’enveloppa dans un drap de lin propre. \v 60 Puis il le déposa dans le tombeau neuf qu’il s’était fait tailler dans le roc, roula une grande pierre devant l’entrée du tombeau et s’en alla.
fr.R: Joseph a pris le corps et l’a enveloppé dans un drap propre, fait de lin. \v 60 Il a mis le corps dans son propre tombeau, un tombeau neuf qu’on avait creusé dans le rocher. Puis il a roulé une grosse pierre devant l’ouverture pour fermer le tombeau, et il est parti.

sw.L: Na Yosefu alipokwisha kuuchukua mwili, aliuzungushia kitambaa kisafi cha kitani, \v 60 kisha akaulaza ndani ya kaburi lake jipya, ambalo alikuwa amelikata katika mwamba; na baada ya kuvingirisha jiwe kubwa hadi kwenye mlango wa kaburi, aliondoka.
sw.B: Yosefu aliuchukua mwili, akauzungushia shuka safi ya kitani. \v 60 Kisha akauweka ndani ya kaburi jipya alilokuwa amejichongea mwambani, akavingirisha jiwe kubwa kuziba mlango wa kaburi, akaenda.
sw.R: Yosefu aliuchukua mwili, akaufunga kwa kitambaa safi cha kitani. \v 60 Akauweka katika kaburi lake jipya lililokuwa limechongwa ndani ya mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kubwa mbele ya mlango ili kulifunga kaburi, akaondoka.

vi.L: Và Giô-sép lấy thi thể, liệm trong một tấm vải gai sạch, \v 60 và đặt trong ngôi mộ mới của ông, mà ông đã đục trong đá; rồi lăn một tảng đá lớn chặn cửa mộ, và ông đi về.
vi.B: Giô-sép nhận thi thể và liệm trong một tấm vải gai sạch. \v 60 Ông đặt thi thể trong ngôi mộ mới mà ông đã cho đục trong vách đá cho chính mình, rồi lăn một tảng đá lớn chặn cửa mộ và ra về.
vi.R: Giô-sép nhận thi thể và quấn trong một tấm vải gai sạch. \v 60 Ông đặt thi thể trong ngôi mộ mới của mình, là ngôi mộ đã được đục trong vách đá. Rồi ông lăn một tảng đá lớn chặn trước lối vào để đóng mộ lại, và ông ra về.

ko.L: 그리고 요셉이 시신을 가져다가 깨끗한 고운 베로 싸서, \v 60 바위를 파서 만든 자기의 새 무덤에 모셨다. 그리고 큰 돌을 무덤 문에 굴려 놓고 떠나갔다.
ko.B: 요셉은 시신을 가져다가 깨끗한 고운 베로 감쌌다. \v 60 그리고 바위를 파서 마련해 둔 자기의 새 무덤에 모시고, 큰 돌을 굴려 무덤 입구를 막은 뒤에 떠나갔다.
ko.R: 요셉은 예수의 시신을 가져다가 깨끗한 고운 베 천으로 감쌌다. \v 60 그리고 바위를 파서 만든 자기의 새 무덤에 시신을 모셨다. 그다음에 큰 돌을 굴려서 무덤 입구를 막고 떠나갔다.

am.L: ዮሴፍም ሥጋውን ወስዶ በንጹሕ በፍታ ጠቀለለው፤ \v 60 በዓለትም ውስጥ በፈለፈለው በራሱ አዲስ መቃብር አኖረው፤ ታላቅ ድንጋይም ወደ መቃብሩ ደጃፍ አንከባሎ ሄደ።
am.B: ዮሴፍም ሥጋውን ወስዶ በንጹሕ የበፍታ ጨርቅ ገነዘው። \v 60 ለራሱ በዓለት ውስጥ ባስፈለፈለው አዲስ መቃብር አኖረው፤ ታላቅ ድንጋይም ወደ መቃብሩ መግቢያ አንከባሎ ሄደ።
am.R: ዮሴፍ አስከሬኑን ወስዶ ከበፍታ በተሠራ ንጹሕ ጨርቅ ጠቀለለው። \v 60 በዓለት ውስጥ በተፈለፈለው በራሱ አዲስ መቃብር ውስጥ አኖረው። ከዚያም መቃብሩን ለመዝጋት ትልቅ ድንጋይ ወደ መግቢያው አንከባለለ፤ ከዚያም ሄደ።

decisions.choice: clean linen: a fresh linen sheet for burial
decisions.reason: The dead were wrapped in linen cloth. A clean, new cloth showed honor to the dead.

decisions.choice: his own new tomb cut in the rock: a family tomb no one had used
decisions.reason: Wealthy families in Jerusalem had tombs cut into the rock, with shelves for bodies inside. Luke 23:53 and John 19:41 say no one had yet been laid in it.

decisions.choice: a great stone at the door: a large stone that closed the entrance
decisions.reason: Such stones were often round and rolled in a groove across the doorway. It will be sealed and guarded (27:66) and rolled away (28:2).

decisions.choice: it, for the body
decisions.reason: The Greek pronoun is neuter and refers to the body. It is not a pronoun for Jesus himself, so it takes no setting.

decisions.choice: "thi thể" for "it", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The Greek pronoun refers to the body, as the English "it" does; Vietnamese repeats "thi thể", the respectful word for a dead body used in Mark 15:43-46.

decisions.choice: "고운 베" (L, B), "고운 베 천" (R) for sindon; "모시다" for laying Jesus in the tomb
decisions.reason: The words of the Korean John 19:40-42 and Mark 15:46; "모시다" keeps the respect the narrative shows Jesus even in death.

source.text: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία καθήμεναι ἀπέναντι τοῦ τάφου.

records.literal_gloss: Was then there Mary the Magdalene and the other Mary sitting opposite the tomb.

en.L: And Mary the Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
en.B: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary too, seated facing the tomb.
en.R: Mary from Magdala and the other Mary were there. They were sitting across from the tomb.

es.L: Y estaban allí María la Magdalena y la otra María, sentadas frente al sepulcro.
es.B: María Magdalena estaba allí, y también la otra María, sentadas frente al sepulcro.
es.R: María, la de Magdala, y la otra María estaban allí. Estaban sentadas frente a la tumba.

fr.L: Or Marie la Magdaléenne était là, et l’autre Marie, assises en face du tombeau.
fr.B: Marie de Magdala était là, et l’autre Marie aussi, assises face au tombeau.
fr.R: Marie de Magdala et l’autre Marie étaient là. Elles étaient assises en face du tombeau.

sw.L: Na Mariamu Magdalene alikuwa pale, na yule Mariamu mwingine, wakiwa wameketi mkabala na kaburi.
sw.B: Mariamu Magdalene alikuwa pale, pamoja na yule Mariamu mwingine; walikuwa wameketi wakilitazama kaburi.
sw.R: Mariamu wa Magdala na yule Mariamu mwingine walikuwa pale. Walikuwa wameketi pale wakilitazama kaburi.

vi.L: Vả, Ma-ri Ma-đơ-len và Ma-ri kia ở đó, ngồi đối diện ngôi mộ.
vi.B: Ma-ri Ma-đơ-len và bà Ma-ri kia cũng có ở đó, ngồi đối diện ngôi mộ.
vi.R: Ma-ri người làng Ma-đơ-la và bà Ma-ri kia ở đó. Họ ngồi đối diện ngôi mộ.

ko.L: 그런데 거기에는 막달라 [여자] 마리아와 다른 마리아가 무덤 맞은편에 앉아 있었다.
ko.B: 막달라 마리아와 다른 마리아도 거기 무덤 맞은편에 앉아 있었다.
ko.R: 막달라에서 온 마리아와 다른 마리아가 거기 있었다. 그들은 무덤 건너편에 앉아 있었다.

am.L: በዚያም መግደላዊት ማርያምና ሌላዋ ማርያም ከመቃብሩ ፊት ለፊት ተቀምጠው ነበር።
am.B: መግደላዊት ማርያምና ሌላዋ ማርያምም በዚያ ነበሩ፤ ፊታቸውን ወደ መቃብሩ አድርገው ተቀምጠው ነበር።
am.R: ከመቅደላ የሆነችው ማርያምና ሌላዋ ማርያም በዚያ ነበሩ። ከመቃብሩ ፊት ለፊት ተቀምጠው ነበር።

decisions.choice: the other Mary: the mother of James and Joseph
decisions.reason: She is the second Mary named in 27:56. The two women will come back to the tomb in 28:1.

decisions.choice: sitting opposite the tomb: they saw where he was laid
decisions.reason: The women see the place of burial, so they know which tomb they find empty (28:1, 6).

decisions.choice: Mary: a second spelling of the same name in the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT spells Mary Magdalene's name in a slightly different form here than in 27:56. It is the same name and the same woman.

source.text: Τῇ δὲ ἐπαύριον, ἥτις ἐστὶν μετὰ τὴν παρασκευήν, συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς Πιλᾶτον λέγοντες· Κύριε, ἐμνήσθημεν ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὁ πλάνος εἶπεν ἔτι ζῶν· Μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἐγείρομαι·

records.literal_gloss: The then next day, which is after the Preparation, were gathered together the chief priests and the Pharisees before Pilate \v 63 saying, Sir, we remembered that that deceiver said while living, After three days I am raised.

en.L: And on the next day, which is after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate \v 63 and said, "Sir, we have remembered that that deceiver said while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still living, 'After three days I am raised.'
en.B: On the following day, the one after the day of Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees came together to Pilate. \v 63 "Sir," they said, "we have remembered something that impostor said while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still alive: 'After three days I will be raised.'
en.R: The next day was the Sabbath, the day after Preparation Day. The leading priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate together. \v 63 They said, "Sir, we remember something that liar said while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still alive. He said, 'After three days I will come back to life.'

es.L: Y al día siguiente, que es después de la Preparación, se reunieron los principales sacerdotes y los fariseos ante Pilato, \v 63 diciendo: «Señor, nos hemos acordado de que aquel engañador dijo estando aún con vida: “Después de tres días soy resucitado”.
es.B: Al día siguiente, el que sigue al día de la Preparación, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los fariseos fueron juntos a ver a Pilato. \v 63 «Señor —le dijeron—, nos hemos acordado de algo que dijo aquel impostor cuando todavía vivía: “Después de tres días seré resucitado”.
es.R: El día siguiente era el sábado, el día después del día de la Preparación. Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los fariseos fueron juntos a ver a Pilato. \v 63 Le dijeron: «Señor, nos acordamos de algo que dijo aquel mentiroso cuando todavía estaba vivo. Dijo: “Después de tres días volveré a la vida”.

fr.L: Or le lendemain, qui est après la Préparation, les chefs des prêtres et les Pharisiens se rassemblèrent auprès de Pilate \v 63 et dirent : « Seigneur, nous nous sommes souvenus que ce trompeur a dit, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était encore vivant : “Après trois jours, je ressuscite.”
fr.B: Le lendemain, c’est-à-dire le jour qui suivait la Préparation, les chefs des prêtres et les Pharisiens se rendirent ensemble chez Pilate. \v 63 « Seigneur, dirent-ils, nous nous sommes souvenus que cet imposteur a dit, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était encore en vie : “Après trois jours, je ressusciterai.”
fr.R: Le lendemain, c’était le sabbat, le jour qui suit la Préparation. Les chefs des prêtres et les Pharisiens sont allés ensemble voir Pilate. \v 63 Ils lui ont dit : « Gouverneur, nous nous rappelons ce que ce menteur a dit quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était encore vivant. Il a dit : “Après trois jours, je reviendrai à la vie.”

sw.L: Na siku iliyofuata, ambayo ni baada ya Maandalio, wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikusanyika kwa Pilato, \v 63 wakisema, "Bwana, tumekumbuka kwamba yule mpotoshaji alisema alipokuwa angali hai, 'Baada ya siku tatu ninafufuliwa.'
sw.B: Siku iliyofuata, yaani siku baada ya Siku ya Maandalio, wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikwenda pamoja kwa Pilato. \v 63 Wakasema, "Bwana, tumekumbuka jambo alilosema yule mdanganyifu alipokuwa bado hai: 'Baada ya siku tatu nitafufuliwa.'
sw.R: Siku iliyofuata ilikuwa Sabato, siku baada ya Siku ya Maandalio. Wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikwenda pamoja kwa Pilato. \v 63 Wakasema, "Bwana, tunakumbuka jambo alilosema yule mwongo alipokuwa bado hai. Alisema, 'Baada ya siku tatu nitarudi uzimani.'

vi.L: Vả, ngày hôm sau, tức là ngày sau ngày Chuẩn Bị, các thầy tế lễ cả và người Pha-ri-si cùng nhau đến gặp Phi-lát \v 63 và nói: "Thưa ngài, chúng tôi nhớ lại rằng kẻ lừa dối ấy, lúc còn sống, đã nói: 'Sau ba ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sống lại.'
vi.B: Ngày hôm sau, tức là ngày sau ngày Chuẩn Bị, các thầy tế lễ cả và người Pha-ri-si cùng nhau đến gặp Phi-lát. \v 63 Họ nói: "Thưa ngài, chúng tôi nhớ có lần kẻ mạo danh ấy, lúc còn sống, đã nói: 'Sau ba ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được sống lại.'
vi.R: Ngày hôm sau là ngày Sa-bát, tức là ngày sau ngày Chuẩn Bị. Các thầy tế lễ cả và người Pha-ri-si cùng nhau đến gặp Phi-lát. \v 63 Họ nói: "Thưa ngài, chúng tôi nhớ lại một điều mà tên nói dối ấy đã nói khi còn sống. Ông ta nói: 'Sau ba ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sống lại.'

ko.L: 그리고 이튿날, 곧 준비일 다음 날에 대제사장들과 바리새파 사람들이 빌라도에게 모여 \v 63 말했다. "총독님, 저 미혹하는 자가 살아 있을 때에 '사흘 후에 내가 살아난다'고 말한 것을 저희가 기억합니다.
ko.B: 이튿날, 곧 준비일 다음 날에 대제사장들과 바리새파 사람들이 함께 빌라도에게 가서 \v 63 말했다. "총독님, 저 사기꾼이 살아 있을 때 '사흘 뒤에 내가 살아날 것이다' 하고 말한 것이 생각났습니다.
ko.R: 다음 날은 안식일이었다. 준비일 다음 날이었다. 대제사장들과 바리새파 사람들이 함께 빌라도에게 갔다. \v 63 그들이 말했다. "총독님, 그 거짓말쟁이가 살아 있을 때 한 말이 생각났습니다. 그는 '사흘 뒤에 나는 다시 살아날 것이다' 하고 말했습니다.

am.L: በማግሥቱም፣ ይኸውም ከዝግጅቱ ቀን በኋላ ባለው ቀን፣ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን በጲላጦስ ዘንድ ተሰበሰቡ፤ \v 63 እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ጌታችን ሆይ፣ ያ አሳች ገና በሕይወት ሳለ፦ “ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ እነሣለሁ” ማለቱን አስታወስን።
am.B: በሚቀጥለው ቀን፣ ማለትም ከዝግጅት ቀን በኋላ ባለው ቀን፣ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን በአንድነት ወደ ጲላጦስ መጡ። \v 63 «ጌታችን ሆይ» አሉ፤ «ያ አሳች ገና በሕይወት ሳለ የተናገረውን አንድ ነገር አስታወስን፤ “ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ እነሣለሁ” ብሎ ነበር።
am.R: በሚቀጥለው ቀን ሰንበት ነበር፤ ይህም ከዝግጅት ቀን በኋላ ያለው ቀን ነው። የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን በአንድነት ወደ ጲላጦስ ሄዱ። \v 63 እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ጌታችን፣ ያ ውሸታም ገና በሕይወት ሳለ የተናገረው ነገር ትዝ አለን። “ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ከሞት ተነሥቼ ሕያው እሆናለሁ” ብሎ ነበር።

decisions.choice: the day after the Preparation: the Sabbath
decisions.reason: Preparation was the day before the Sabbath, the Friday on which Jesus died. The next day was the Sabbath itself.

decisions.choice: deceiver: one who leads people astray
