decisions.reason: The word means one who misleads. Jesus warned that false messiahs would lead many astray (24:4-5, 24); his enemies call him one.

decisions.choice: I am raised: the present for a sure future; it can mean I rise or I am raised
decisions.reason: Jesus foretold that he would be raised on the third day (16:21; 17:23; 20:19). The leaders quote the promise to guard against it.

decisions.choice: Sir: a polite address
alternatives: Lord, as a confession of faith
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "Lord", but spoken to Pilate it is a title of respect.

decisions.choice: The next day was the Sabbath
decisions.reason: Readable says which day it was. Pronouns for Jesus take the deity_pronoun setting even in his enemies' words; a pronoun at the start of a sentence is written plain.

decisions.choice: soy resucitado (L); seré resucitado (B); volveré a la vida (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present, which speaks of a sure future (meaning decision m3); Balanced keeps the passive, as the English does, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: Seigneur (L, B); Gouverneur (R); "tu" to Pilate at every level
decisions.reason: The address is a polite title (m4). "Monsieur" is too slight for a Roman governor, and "Excellence" sits badly with "tu"; "Seigneur" is the old French address to a man in power, and Readable uses his office instead. The Greek command is singular, so the priests say "tu" (style guide §6).

decisions.choice: ce trompeur (L); cet imposteur (B); ce menteur (R)
decisions.reason: The word means one who leads people astray (m2). "Séducteur" now suggests romance; Literal says "trompeur", Balanced the usual word for a false claimant, Readable the plain word the English uses.

decisions.choice: Bwana, as polite address
decisions.reason: The word is a polite "sir" to the governor (meaning decision m4), lowercase "bwana" in Swahili; it has a capital here only because it opens the speech.

decisions.choice: mpotoshaji ... upotoshaji (L); mdanganyifu ... udanganyifu (B); mwongo ... uongo (R)
decisions.reason: The word means one who leads people astray (meaning decision m2). Literal says "mpotoshaji" so that the same root can be seen again in "upotoshaji" (deception) in 27:64; Balanced and Readable use the everyday words, as the English "impostor" and "liar" do.

decisions.choice: "Thưa ngài" to Pilate; "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: A polite address to the governor (meaning decision); "ngài" here is ordinary respect for an official, written lowercase and with no setting span.

decisions.choice: "kẻ lừa dối ấy" (L); "kẻ mạo danh ấy" (B); "tên nói dối ấy" (R); no pronoun for Jesus
decisions.reason: The leaders speak of Jesus with contempt; Vietnamese leaves out the pronoun in "while he was alive", so the English span has no counterpart. The words they quote keep Jesus' own "Ta".

decisions.choice: The chief priests and Pharisees speak to Pilate in 합쇼체 with "총독님" and "저희", and of Jesus with no honorific, through 27:64; Pilate answers in the plain style
decisions.reason: kyrie here is a polite address to the governor (meaning decision); "총독님" is the Korean way to address an official by rank. They call Jesus a deceiver, so they give him no honorific.

decisions.choice: "미혹하는 자" (L); "사기꾼" (B); "거짓말쟁이" (R) for planos; "살아나다" for egeiromai
decisions.reason: One who leads people astray (meaning decision); "미혹하다" is the Literal verb for planao in the Korean Matthew 24:4, and Balanced and Readable say it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "ጌታችን ሆይ" ("our lord") for "Sir", and the respectful "እርስዎ" forms to Pilate in 27:64 ("ይዘዙ", "ይስጡ")
alternatives: "ጌታ ሆይ" (the address to God and Jesus)
decisions.reason: Subordinates speaking to the Roman governor use the respectful forms, as the Amharic style guide sets for rulers; "ጌታችን" is a polite address to a superior and does not call Pilate "Lord" in the sense used of God.

decisions.choice: "የዝግጅት ቀን" (the day of Preparation)
decisions.reason: Matthew names the day by what it was for, getting ready for the Sabbath; Amharic keeps that name rather than the weekday.

source.text: κέλευσον οὖν ἀσφαλισθῆναι τὸν τάφον ἕως τῆς τρίτης ἡμέρας, μήποτε ἐλθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ κλέψωσιν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴπωσιν τῷ λαῷ· Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἔσται ἡ ἐσχάτη πλάνη χείρων τῆς πρώτης.

records.literal_gloss: Command therefore to be secured the tomb until the third day, lest having come the disciples of him they steal him and say to the people, He was raised from the dead, and will be the last deception worse than the first.

en.L: So command that the tomb be made secure until the third day, so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples do not come and steal {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and say to the people, 'He has been raised from the dead,' and the last deception will be worse than the first."
en.B: Give the command, then, to have the tomb guarded securely until the third day. If not, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples could come, take {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} away by stealth, and announce to the people, 'He has been raised from the dead.' And this final fraud would do more harm than the first one."
en.R: So please give orders for the tomb to be guarded until the third day. If you do not, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers might come and steal {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body. Then they would tell the people, 'He has come back from death!' This last lie would be even worse than the first one."

es.L: Manda, pues, que el sepulcro sea asegurado hasta el tercer día, no sea que vengan {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} roben y digan al pueblo: “Fue resucitado de entre los muertos”, y el último engaño sea peor que el primero».
es.B: Da orden, entonces, de que el sepulcro quede bien vigilado hasta el tercer día. De lo contrario, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos podrían venir, llevárselo a escondidas y anunciar al pueblo: “Ha sido resucitado de entre los muertos”. Y este último fraude sería peor que el primero».
es.R: Por favor, da orden de que vigilen la tumba hasta el tercer día. Si no, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} seguidores podrían venir y robar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo. Después le dirían a la gente: “¡Ha vuelto de la muerte!”. Esta última mentira sería todavía peor que la primera».

fr.L: Ordonne donc que le tombeau soit mis en sûreté jusqu’au troisième jour, de peur que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples ne viennent {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} voler et ne disent au peuple : “Il a été ressuscité des morts”, et la dernière imposture sera pire que la première. »
fr.B: Donne donc l’ordre de garder le tombeau en sûreté jusqu’au troisième jour. Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples pourraient venir {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}enlever en secret, puis annoncer au peuple : “Il a été ressuscité des morts.” Et cette dernière tromperie ferait plus de mal que la première. »
fr.R: Alors, s’il te plaît, donne l’ordre de faire garder le tombeau jusqu’au troisième jour. Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples risquent de venir voler {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps. Ensuite, ils diraient aux gens : “Il est revenu de la mort !” Ce dernier mensonge serait encore pire que le premier. »

sw.L: Basi agiza kaburi lilindwe kwa uthabiti mpaka siku ya tatu, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wasije wakaja wakamwiba na kuwaambia watu, 'Amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu,' na upotoshaji wa mwisho ukawa mbaya zaidi kuliko wa kwanza."
sw.B: Kwa hiyo toa amri kaburi lilindwe vizuri mpaka siku ya tatu. La sivyo, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wanaweza kuja na kumchukua kwa siri, kisha wakawatangazia watu, 'Amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.' Na udanganyifu huu wa mwisho utaleta madhara makubwa kuliko ule wa kwanza."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tafadhali toa amri kaburi lilindwe mpaka siku ya tatu. Usipofanya hivyo, wafuasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wanaweza kuja na kuiba mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kisha watawaambia watu, 'Amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu!' Uongo huu wa mwisho utakuwa mbaya kuliko ule wa kwanza."

vi.L: Vậy xin ngài ra lệnh canh giữ ngôi mộ cho chắc chắn cho đến ngày thứ ba, kẻo các môn đồ của ông ta đến lấy trộm ông ta, rồi nói với dân chúng: 'Ông ấy đã được sống lại từ cõi chết,' và sự lừa dối sau cùng sẽ tệ hại hơn sự lừa dối trước."
vi.B: Vậy xin ngài ra lệnh canh giữ ngôi mộ cho cẩn thận cho đến ngày thứ ba. Nếu không, các môn đồ của ông ta có thể đến lén lấy xác đi, rồi loan báo với dân chúng: 'Ông ấy đã được sống lại từ cõi chết.' Và lần lừa bịp sau cùng này sẽ còn tệ hại hơn lần trước."
vi.R: Vậy xin ngài ra lệnh canh giữ ngôi mộ cho đến ngày thứ ba. Nếu không, các môn đồ của ông ta có thể đến lấy trộm xác. Rồi họ sẽ nói với dân chúng: 'Ông ấy đã sống lại từ cõi chết!' Lời nói dối sau cùng này sẽ còn tệ hơn lời nói dối trước."

ko.L: 그러니 사흘째 되는 날까지 무덤을 단단히 지키라고 명령해 주십시오. 그의 제자들이 와서 그를 훔쳐 가고, 백성에게 '그가 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아났다' 하고 말하지 못하게 하십시오. 그러면 나중 속임이 처음 것보다 더 나쁠 것입니다."
ko.B: 그러니 사흘째 되는 날까지 무덤을 단단히 지키라고 명령해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 그의 제자들이 와서 시체를 몰래 훔쳐 가고는, 백성에게 '그가 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아났다' 하고 퍼뜨릴 것입니다. 그러면 이번 속임수가 처음 것보다 더 큰 해를 끼칠 것입니다."
ko.R: 그러니 사흘째 되는 날까지 무덤을 지키라고 명령해 주십시오. 그렇지 않으면 그의 제자들이 와서 시체를 훔쳐 갈지도 모릅니다. 그러고는 사람들에게 '그가 죽었다가 다시 살아났다!' 하고 말할 것입니다. 이번 거짓말은 처음 거짓말보다 훨씬 더 나쁠 것입니다."

am.L: ስለዚህ መቃብሩ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ ይዘዙ፤ አለበለዚያ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው ይሰርቁትና ለሕዝቡ፦ “ከሙታን ተነሥቷል” ይሉ ይሆናል፤ የኋለኛውም ማታለል ከፊተኛው የከፋ ይሆናል።»
am.B: ስለዚህ መቃብሩ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን ድረስ በጥንቃቄ እንዲጠበቅ ትእዛዝ ይስጡ። አለበለዚያ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው በስውር ሊወስዱትና ለሕዝቡ፦ “ከሙታን ተነሥቷል” ብለው ሊያውጁ ይችላሉ። ይህ የመጨረሻው ማጭበርበርም ከመጀመሪያው የበለጠ ጉዳት ያመጣል።»
am.R: ስለዚህ እባክዎ መቃብሩ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ ትእዛዝ ይስጡ። ይህን ካላደረጉ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው አስከሬኑን ሊሰርቁ ይችላሉ። ከዚያም ለሕዝቡ፦ “ከሞት ተነሥቷል!” ይላሉ። ይህ የመጨረሻው ውሸት ከመጀመሪያው እጅግ የከፋ ይሆናል።»

decisions.choice: the last deception, the first: a report of resurrection would be worse than his claims while alive
decisions.reason: The first deception, as the leaders see it, is Jesus's own claim to be the Messiah and the Son of God (26:63-64). The last would be the news that he rose.

decisions.choice: until the third day: counting the day of his death as the first
decisions.reason: The third day was the day after the Sabbath, the day of 28:1.

decisions.choice: steal him: carry off his body
decisions.reason: The leaders speak of Jesus himself, though they mean the body.

decisions.choice: his body
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the leaders mean his body. The pronoun still refers to Jesus and takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "ông ta", "ông ấy" for Jesus, with no deity_pronoun span; "xác" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Opponents speak of Jesus as "ông ta", which has no reverent capital form, as in 26:65; Balanced and Readable say "the body", as the meaning decision and the English Readable do, with the leaders' blunt word "xác".

decisions.choice: "시체" (B, R) in the leaders' mouths, for "him"
decisions.reason: Steal him means carry off his body (meaning decision); the leaders, who scorn Jesus, use the blunt word, where the narrator says the respectful "시신".

decisions.choice: The purpose clause made a second request, "... 말하지 못하게 하십시오" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot hang a negative purpose clause and the final "and the last deception will be" on one command; Literal keeps every part in order with two requests and a closing sentence.

source.text: ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Ἔχετε κουστωδίαν· ὑπάγετε ἀσφαλίσασθε ὡς οἴδατε.

records.literal_gloss: Said to them the Pilate, You have a guard; go, make secure as you know.

en.L: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard; go, make [it] as secure as you know [how]."
en.B: Pilate told them, "You may have a guard. Go and secure it in whatever way you think best."
en.R: Pilate said, "You can have some soldiers. Go and guard the tomb the best way you know."

es.L: Pilato les dijo: «{{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} una guardia; {{plural_you:vayan|id}}, {{plural_you:aseguren|asegurad}} [el sepulcro] como {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}}».
es.B: Pilato les respondió: «{{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} llevar una guardia. {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:asegúrenlo|aseguradlo}} como mejor {{plural_you:les|os}} parezca».
es.R: Pilato les dijo: «{{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} llevarse unos soldados. {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:vigilen|vigilad}} la tumba lo mejor que {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}}».

fr.L: Pilate leur dit : « Vous avez une garde ; allez, mettez[-le] en sûreté comme vous savez [le faire]. »
fr.B: Pilate leur répondit : « Vous pouvez avoir une garde. Allez, et protégez le tombeau comme vous le jugerez bon. »
fr.R: Pilate a dit : « Vous pouvez prendre des soldats. Allez garder le tombeau du mieux que vous pouvez. »

sw.L: Pilato aliwaambia, "Mnayo askari wa ulinzi; nendeni, mkalifanye [kaburi] kuwa salama kwa kadiri mnavyojua."
sw.B: Pilato aliwajibu, "Mnaweza kuchukua walinzi. Nendeni mkalilinde kaburi kwa njia mnayoona ni bora."
sw.R: Pilato akasema, "Mnaweza kuchukua askari. Nendeni mkalinde kaburi kwa njia mnayojua ni bora."

vi.L: Phi-lát nói với họ: "Các ông có lính canh; hãy đi canh giữ cho chắc chắn theo như các ông biết."
vi.B: Phi-lát bảo họ: "Các ông cứ lấy lính canh. Hãy đi canh giữ ngôi mộ cho chắc chắn theo cách các ông cho là tốt nhất."
vi.R: Phi-lát nói: "Các ông có thể lấy một toán lính. Hãy đi canh giữ ngôi mộ theo cách tốt nhất các ông biết."

ko.L: 빌라도가 그들에게 말했다. "너희에게 경비병이 있다. 가서 너희가 아는 대로 단단히 지켜라."
ko.B: 빌라도가 그들에게 말했다. "경비병들을 데려가거라. 가서 너희 생각대로 무덤을 단단히 지켜라."
ko.R: 빌라도가 말했다. "병사들을 데려가거라. 가서 너희가 할 수 있는 대로 무덤을 잘 지켜라."

am.L: ጲላጦስም፦ «ጠባቂዎች አላችሁ፤ ሂዱ፤ እንደምታውቁት አስጠብቁ» አላቸው።
am.B: ጲላጦስም፦ «ጠባቂ ወታደሮች መውሰድ ትችላላችሁ። ሂዱና በተሻለ በምታስቡት መንገድ አስጠብቁት» አላቸው።
am.R: ጲላጦስም፦ «አንዳንድ ወታደሮችን መውሰድ ትችላላችሁ። ሂዱና በምታውቁት መንገድ መቃብሩን አስጠብቁ» አላቸው።

decisions.choice: you have a guard: take a guard of soldiers
alternatives: you have your own temple guard
decisions.reason: The verb can be a statement or a command. The guards later report to the chief priests (28:11), which could suit the temple police; but the leaders promise to keep them out of trouble with the governor (28:14), which suits Roman soldiers.

decisions.choice: guard: a group of soldiers on watch
decisions.reason: The word comes from Latin and names a detachment of guards.

decisions.choice: You may have (B); You can have (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading as a command or permission, which the meaning decision marks as uncertain.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on the words addressed to the priests and Pharisees ({{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} and onward)
decisions.reason: Spanish has two plural forms of "you", Latin American "ustedes" and Peninsular "vosotros"; the setting chooses between them. English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart. The same throughout the passage; Pilate alone is addressed with "tú" (27:64).

decisions.choice: Pilate to the leaders: "các ông"
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese John, Pilate speaks to members of the council as "các ông", and to the crowd as "các người" (27:17).

decisions.choice: "경비병" (L, B); "병사들" (R) for koustodia
decisions.reason: A guard of soldiers on watch (meaning decision); "파수꾼" is the older church word.

source.text: οἱ δὲ πορευθέντες ἠσφαλίσαντο τὸν τάφον σφραγίσαντες τὸν λίθον μετὰ τῆς κουστωδίας.

records.literal_gloss: They then having gone made secure the tomb having sealed the stone with the guard.

en.L: So they went and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone along with the guard.
en.B: They went and sealed the stone, and with the guard in place they made the tomb secure.
en.R: So they went to the tomb. They put a seal on the stone, and they left soldiers there to guard it.

es.L: Y ellos, yendo, aseguraron el sepulcro, sellando la piedra junto con la guardia.
es.B: Ellos fueron y sellaron la piedra, y con la guardia apostada aseguraron el sepulcro.
es.R: Así que fueron a la tumba. Pusieron un sello en la piedra, y dejaron allí soldados para vigilarla.

fr.L: Et eux, s’en étant allés, mirent le tombeau en sûreté, en scellant la pierre, avec la garde.
fr.B: Ils s’en allèrent, scellèrent la pierre et, avec la garde postée là, mirent le tombeau en sûreté.
fr.R: Alors ils sont allés au tombeau. Ils ont mis un sceau sur la pierre, et ils ont laissé des soldats pour le garder.

sw.L: Nao walipokwenda, waliliimarisha kaburi, wakiweka muhuri juu ya jiwe pamoja na askari wa ulinzi.
sw.B: Walikwenda, wakaweka muhuri juu ya jiwe, na kwa kuwaweka walinzi pale wakalifanya kaburi kuwa salama.
sw.R: Basi walikwenda kaburini. Waliweka muhuri juu ya lile jiwe, wakawaacha askari pale ili walilinde.

vi.L: Vậy họ đi canh giữ ngôi mộ cho chắc chắn, niêm phong tảng đá cùng với lính canh.
vi.B: Họ đi niêm phong tảng đá, và đặt lính canh để giữ ngôi mộ cho chắc chắn.
vi.R: Vậy họ đi đến ngôi mộ. Họ niêm phong tảng đá, và để lính ở đó canh giữ.

ko.L: 그래서 그들은 가서 경비병과 함께 돌을 봉인하여 무덤을 단단히 지켰다.
ko.B: 그들은 가서 돌을 봉인하고 경비병을 세워 무덤을 단단히 지켰다.
ko.R: 그들은 무덤으로 갔다. 그리고 돌에 봉인을 하고, 병사들을 그곳에 남겨 무덤을 지키게 했다.

am.L: እነርሱም ሄደው ድንጋዩን አትመው ከጠባቂዎቹ ጋር መቃብሩን አስጠበቁ።
am.B: እነርሱም ሄደው ድንጋዩን አተሙ፤ ጠባቂዎቹንም አቁመው መቃብሩን አስጠበቁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ወደ መቃብሩ ሄዱ። በድንጋዩ ላይ ማኅተም አደረጉ፤ እንዲጠብቁትም ወታደሮችን በዚያ ተዉ።

decisions.choice: sealing the stone: a cord or wax seal, so that tampering would show
decisions.reason: A seal across the stone and the rock would be broken if anyone moved it (compare Daniel 6:17).

decisions.choice: with the guard: by posting the guard as well
decisions.reason: The tomb was made secure in two ways: by the seal and by the soldiers.

decisions.choice: "niêm phong"
decisions.reason: A seal of cord or wax that would show any tampering (meaning decision); "niêm phong" is the everyday word for such a seal.

decisions.choice: "봉인하다" for sphragizo
decisions.reason: A cord or wax seal that would show any tampering (meaning decision); "인봉하다" is the older word.
